title: Is there a density-gradient expansion for the electronic exchange energy?
summary: An old but recurring question in ground-state density functional theory, relevant to the construction of density functional approximations, is the existence of a second-order gradient expansion for the exchange energy that is exact for densities that vary slowly over space. Here we will argue that there is such an expansion, with a gradient coefficient 10/7 of Sham's, as suggested by theoretical/mathematical derivations and by numerical calculations on model slowly-varying metallic densities, although some standard derivations do not quite capture the correct gradient coefficient. We also discuss long-range anomalies in the gradient expansions for the exchange and correlation holes around an electron. It is plausible that, as suggested earlier and recently, standard derivations are still correct for the coefficient of the second-order gradient expansion for exchange and correlation together, in which case the correct gradient coefficient for correlation is $C_{\mathrm{c}}$ = $C_{\mathrm{xc}}$ - $C_{\mathrm{x}}$. We propose possible numerical evaluations of $C_{\mathrm{xc}}$ and $C_{\mathrm{x}}$ that are free from long-range anomalies, and discuss implications for density functional approximations. Axel Becke's 1988 generalized gradient approximation (the B88 GGA) for the exchange energy brought density functional theory into chemistry, with a gradient coefficient for exchange that is optimal at the GGA level for atoms and molecules but too large for solids. Meta-GGAs seem to work as well for molecules as for solids, but may not be perfected yet. The article concludes with a few memories that the first author has of discussions with Axel Becke.

AI.tldr: 本文论证交换能存在二阶梯度展开，其梯度系数为Sham的10/7，并讨论交换/相关孔的长程异常及相关泛函近似的影响。
AI.motivation: 密度泛函近似构建中，交换能二阶梯度展开是否对缓变密度精确这一老问题反复出现，需澄清正确梯度系数。
AI.method: 结合理论/数学推导与模型缓变金属密度的数值计算，分析梯度展开及长程异常，并提出无长程异常的C_xc与C_x数值评估方案。
AI.result: 理论推导与数值计算支持交换梯度系数为Sham的10/7，而部分标准推导未能捕捉正确系数；标准推导对交换与相关合起来的二阶系数可能仍正确，则相关系数C_c = C_xc - C_x。B88 GGA交换梯度系数对原子分子最优但对固体过大；meta-GGA对分子和固体表现相近但可能尚未完善。
AI.conclusion: 交换存在正确的二阶梯度展开，需注意长程异常并以无异常方式评估系数；对密度泛函近似的构建具启示，文末回忆与Axel Becke的讨论。

title: Many-body Interactions in Ultrafast Spectroscopy
summary: Nonlinear spectroscopy is widely used to probe ultrafast dynamics in matter. Signals of higher nonlinear orders encode valuable many-body dynamics but only recently have become individually retrievable. However, their physical interpretation in terms of double-sided Feynman diagrams is cumbersome and non-intuitive. Here, we establish an alternative framework that connects them to the underlying excitation conditions and many-body interactions. This approach predicts two classes of dynamic nonlinearities, due either to direct many-body interactions or to saturable kinetic channels. The method provides a direct physical interpretation of the retrieved signals, explaining their sign, magnitude, and dynamics. It also enables model-free reconstruction of the dynamics of a sub-ensemble of particles starting with a given number of excitons, which we demonstrate to be especially insightful. We validate the framework using colloidal CdSe/CdS core/shell quantum dots, which enable us to model nonlinearities of both classes in isolation and also combined.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新框架，将高阶非线性光谱信号与激发条件及多体相互作用关联，预测两类动态非线性并实现无模型子系综动力学重构。
AI.motivation: 高阶非线性光谱虽可探测多体动力学，但用双面Feynman图解释繁琐且不直观，亟需更直观的物理框架。
AI.method: 建立连接高阶非线性信号与激发条件、多体相互作用的替代框架，区分两类动态非线性：直接多体相互作用型与可饱和动力学通道型，并据此实现子系综动力学无模型重构。
AI.result: 框架可直接解释信号符号、幅度与动力学；以胶体CdSe/CdS核壳量子点验证，可分别及联合建模两类非线性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高阶非线性光谱提供直观物理诠释，并能无模型重构特定激子数子系综动力学，具有较强启发意义。

title: Coupled cluster theory for multireference and open-shell molecules
summary: We introduce a simple coupled cluster approach for multireference and open-shell systems. In the restricted active space coupled cluster framework, the cluster operator only includes excitations from doubly occupied to virtual orbitals, and this ensures the individual operators commute among each other. The ground and excited states are obtained by diagonalisation of the coupled cluster similarity transformed Hamiltonian in a restricted active space. We demonstrate the framework for the RAS-CCSD model, where single and double excitations are included in the cluster operator, and likewise for a complete active space. We consider systems with multireference character and open-shell systems in a spin-adapted manner. The approach captures significantly more dynamical correlation than without the coupled cluster similarity transformation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种简单的耦合簇方法用于多参考和开壳层体系，在限制活性空间框架下，簇算符仅包含从双占据到虚拟轨道的激发，保证各算符互相对易，并在限制活性空间中通过对相似变换哈密顿量进行对角化获得基态和激发态。
AI.motivation: 多参考和开壳层体系的电子结构计算具有挑战性，需要一种能同时有效处理多参考特征与开壳层性质、并能捕获较多动态关联的简单方法。
AI.method: 在限制活性空间耦合簇（RAS-CC）框架下，簇算符只含从双占据到虚拟轨道的激发，从而保证算符间对易。通过将耦合簇相似变换后的哈密顿量在限制活性空间中对角化，得到基态和激发态。以RAS-CCSD模型（含单、双激发）为例进行演示，并以自旋适配方式处理体系。
AI.result: 在含多参考特征和开壳层的体系中验证了该框架，RAS-CCSD相比未做耦合簇相似变换的方法能捕获显著更多的动态关联。
AI.conclusion: 该RAS-CC框架简单且适用于多参考和开壳层体系，能有效纳入动态关联，为基态和激发态计算提供可行途径。

title: What Rate Theories Compute: Chemical kinetics from Arrhenius to machine-learned potentials
comment: Review article. 41 pages: 31-page main manuscript and 10-page Supplementary Materials; 2 tables and 1 graphical abstract
summary: Major advances in chemical rate theory changed what was computed and what a barrier meant. I organize this conceptual history around those changes, while retaining the controlled corrections and limiting relations between theories. The calculated quantities include an empirical rate constant, a collision count, a thermodynamic activation free energy, a statistical flux across a dividing surface, a stochastic escape rate, an energy-resolved microcanonical rate, a quantum flux correlation function, and an ensemble of reactive paths computed with electronic-structure or machine-learned potentials. I compare the assumptions with the limits stated by the pioneering authors. A rate constant is inferred from measurements under a stated rate law; its temperature dependence defines an apparent activation energy $E_a$. Activation free energy $ΔG^{\ddagger}$, activation enthalpy $ΔH^{\ddagger}$, activation entropy $ΔS^{\ddagger}$, the prefactor, transmission coefficient $κ$, and saddle height require a kinetic model and, where relevant, a standard state, dividing surface, ensemble, and dynamical correction for their interpretation in a rate calculation. In hydrogen transfer by soybean lipoxygenase-1, similar single-isotope activation parameters accompany a large change in isotope-sensitive dynamics. Five rate benchmarks illustrate the errors different comparisons test and motivate seven reporting items. These distinctions guide comparisons of rates and interpretations of activation parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文以概念史视角梳理化学速率理论的演变，强调各理论间受控修正与极限关系，并通过五个基准案例澄清速率常数与活化参数的解读条件，提出七项报告规范。
AI.motivation: 化学速率理论的重大进展不断改变"计算什么"以及"势垒意味着什么"，但不同理论中速率常数、活化自由能等概念常被混用比较，导致解读歧义。作者希望保留各理论间的受控修正与极限关系，厘清概念的对应与边界。
AI.method: 以概念史方式组织，逐一列出被计算的量：经验速率常数、碰撞计数、热力学活化自由能、跨分割面的统计通量、随机逃逸速率、能量分辨的微正则速率、量子通量关联函数、以及用电子结构或机器学习势计算的反应路径系综。随后将各理论的假设与先驱作者所声明的极限条件进行比较，并用大豆脂氧合酶-1（SLO-1）氢转移和五个速率基准案例加以说明。
AI.result: 速率常数须在给定速率定律下由测量推断，其温度依赖定义表观活化能E_a；ΔG‡、ΔH‡、ΔS‡、前因子、透射系数κ和鞍点高度都需依赖动力学模型，并在相关时需明确标准态、分割面、系综与动力学修正才能解释。SLO-1案例显示相似的单同位素活化参数可伴随对同位素敏感动力学的巨大变化。五个基准揭示了不同比较所检验的误差类型。
AI.conclusion: 区分这些概念有助于正确比较速率与解读活化参数，并由此提出七项报告条目，作为速率比较和活化参数解释的指南。

title: Luttinger Liquid Behavior in a Single-Layer Nickelate La1.4Sr0.6NiO4
summary: The discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in bilayer and trilayer nickelates has spurred intense interest in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates; yet the fundamental properties of the NiO2 layer remain obscured by interlayer coupling. It is therefore imperative to investigate the electronic properties of their single-layer counterpart to isolate the intrinsic physics of the NiO layer. In this work, we present a systematic study of the single-layer nickelate La1.4Sr0.6NiO4 using high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and theoretical calculations. We reveal strong electron correlation effects, manifested by high-energy kinks in band dispersions and a pronounced orbital-dependent band renormalization. Interestingly, we observe a quasi-one-dimensional electronic structure characterized by straight Fermi surface sheets along the diagonal momentum directions. Such square Fermi surface topology facilitates non-Fermi liquid behavior consistent with the Luttinger liquid model, as evidenced by the power-law spectral function, robust temperature scaling, and the observation of spin-charge separation. Our results therefore not only unveil an exotic Luttinger liquid behavior emerging from the unexpected dimensional reduction in an intrinsically quasi-two-dimensional nickelate but also provide a new perspective for understanding the intriguing physics in multilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 通过ARPES与理论计算研究单层镍酸盐La1.4Sr0.6NiO4，揭示强电子关联及意外的一维Luttinger液体行为。
AI.motivation: 多层镍酸盐高温超导引发关注，但层间耦合掩盖了NiO2层的本征性质，需研究单层对应物以隔离NiO层的固有物理。
AI.method: 采用高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）结合理论计算，系统研究单层镍酸盐La1.4Sr0.6NiO4。
AI.result: 发现强电子关联（高能扭折、轨道依赖的能带重整化）；观察到沿对角动量方向的直线费米面片所构成的准一维电子结构；其方形费米面拓扑导致非费米液体行为（幂律谱函数、稳健温度标度、自旋-电荷分离）。
AI.conclusion: 在本质准二维镍酸盐中，维度约化意外地诱发了奇异Luttinger液体行为，并为理解多层镍酸盐物理提供了新视角。

title: A density-based topology optimization framework for steady Navier-Stokes flow with design-dependent wall actuation
summary: Design-dependent wall velocities are difficult to treat in density-based fluid topology optimization. This difficulty arises because the fluid-solid interface is represented implicitly and evolves with the design. This paper proposes a diffuse-interface formulation for topology optimization of steady incompressible Navier-Stokes flows with design-dependent wall actuation. A continuous topological description field parameterized by compactly supported radial basis functions (CS-RBFs) provides the local interface orientation, and its regularized projection defines the pseudo-density for Brinkman flow analysis. The wall velocity is imposed on a fixed mesh through an equivalent volumetric momentum source, which is localized by a diffuse-interface measure constructed from the pseudo-density and the gradient of the description field. Assuming a locally planar interface and uniformly distributed Wendland radial basis functions, the source coefficient is determined analytically by balancing the equivalent momentum input with the Brinkman resistance at the interface center. These assumptions also yield a characteristic transition-width estimate in terms of the projection steepness and support radius. Continuous adjoint analysis is performed to derive the design sensitivities. Two- and three-dimensional examples formulated using the analogy equation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed topology optimization method for flow-rate maximization. Body-fitted re-simulations verify the flow fields and transport performance of the optimized designs. The formulation is further extended to electroosmotic transport under the thin electric double layer (EDL) assumption using the Helmholtz-Smoluchowski relation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种扩散界面方法，用于含设计相关壁面驱动的稳态不可压Navier-Stokes流体拓扑优化。
AI.motivation: 密度法流体拓扑优化中，流固界面隐式演化，使得设计相关的壁面速度难以处理。
AI.method: 用紧支撑径向基函数（CS-RBF）参数化连续拓扑描述场并获取界面取向，正则投影定义伪密度作Brinkman分析；通过等效体积动量源在固定网格上施加壁速，源系数由动量输入与界面中心Brinkman阻力平衡解析确定；采用连续伴随法求灵敏度。
AI.result: 二、三维类比方程算例验证了流量最大化拓扑优化有效性；贴体网格重仿真验证了优化设计的流场与输运性能；并扩展到薄EDL假设下基于Helmholtz-Smoluchowski关系的电渗输运。
AI.conclusion: 该扩散界面表述可有效处理设计相关壁面驱动，适用于流动与电渗输运问题的拓扑优化。

title: A numerical and efficient model for thermo-field electron emission calculations
summary: As electron sources are reduced in size, fabricated in new materials, or pushed for performance, the analytical formulations for thermo-field electron emission, namely Fowler-Nordheim and Murphy-Good equations and their JWKB-based extensions, are increasingly applied out of the range of conditions for which they were derived. We present GETELEC-3, an open-source code that replaces them with a direct numerical solution of the one-dimensional time-independent Schrödinger equation (1D-TISE). Several methods to solve the 1D-TISE have been implemented to test for speed, robustness, and solution's uncertainty. The Noumerov algorithm is found to be quickest, with the solution uncertainty below 1%, and together with an optimised kernel that advances all electron energies in parallel, the cost of calculating the current density is reduced to a few milliseconds - comparable to the JWKB evaluation. To further boost the calculation speed, especially in complicated barriers, a neural network has been trained on the residual of the logarithm of the semiclassical reference and it reproduces the current density better than 0.4% at a fraction of the computational cost. The code is developed for metals and semiconductors, accepts arbitrary potentials and density of states, and comes with a user-friendly interface and compiled executable to democratise rigorous electron emission calculations and data analysis.

AI.tldr: GETELEC-3是一个开源代码，用直接数值求解一维定态薛定谔方程替代传统的热场发射解析公式，实现快速、鲁棒的电子发射电流密度计算。
AI.motivation: 随着电子源尺寸减小、使用新材料或追求更高性能，传统的热场发射解析公式（Fowler-Nordheim、Murphy-Good及其JWKB扩展）越来越被应用于其推导范围之外的条件，导致准确性不足。
AI.method: 实现多种求解一维定态薛定谔方程（1D-TISE）的方法，比较速度、鲁棒性和不确定性；采用Noumerov算法并配合并行推进所有电子能量的优化内核；训练神经网络拟合半经典参考对数残差以加速复杂势垒计算。代码支持金属和半导体、任意势和态密度。
AI.result: Noumerov算法最快，解的不确定度低于1%，电流密度计算耗时降至几毫秒，与JWKB评估相当；神经网络方法在极低计算成本下重现电流密度误差优于0.4%。
AI.conclusion: GETELEC-3提供用户友好界面和编译可执行文件，普及严格的电子发射计算与数据分析。

title: Proposing one-sided tetrons as topological qubits for Majorana-based quantum computation
summary: One-dimensional SM-SC hybrid nanowires with Rashba spin-orbit coupling and applied Zeeman field can support Majorana zero modes (MZMs) at the ends of the wire. In finite-length systems, residual wave-function overlap between the end modes produces an energy splitting. In a two-sided tetron qubit, composed of a pair of parallel Majorana wires coupled by a trivial SC backbone in the middle, this splitting limits the parity lifetime associated with Majorana pairs involving both wires and the coherence of the qubit, adversely affecting measurement-based braiding and readout operations. Here, we propose a one-sided tetron made of four parallel Majorana wires connected at a common end by an SC backbone. In the topological phase, the free wire ends host four MZMs that define the topological qubit, while the Majoranas localized near the opposite ends hybridize through the backbone and acquire finite energy. To study the basic hybridization mechanism, we consider a simpler two-wire subsystem, i.e., half of a one-sided tetron, which we call a doublon. In a doublon, the backbone, or bridge, strongly hybridizes the two Majorana modes at the connected end and shifts them away from zero energy, while the modes at the free ends form a near-zero energy fermion. We show that the splitting of the surviving MZM pair can fall by about two orders of magnitude compared to the splitting energies in a two-sided tetron, thereby dramatically increasing the parity lifetimes. Thus, the one-sided tetron ensures a suppression of the Majorana overlap comparable to doubling the length of the corresponding two-sided tetron.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“单侧tetron”结构：四根平行的Majorana纳米线共端连接同一SC backbone，另一自由端承载四个MZM。通过研究其两线子系统（doublon），证明该结构可将MZM对能级劈裂降低约两个数量级，从而显著提升宇称寿命，效果相当于把双侧tetron长度加倍。
AI.motivation: 一维SM-SC混合纳米线可支持MZM，但有限长系统中两端MZM波函数重叠导致能级劈裂。在双侧tetron中，该劈裂限制了涉及双线的Majorana对的宇称寿命及量子比特相干性，损害基于测量的编织与读出操作。
AI.method: 设计由四根平行Majorana线在一端通过SC backbone共端连接的“单侧tetron”。为研究基本杂化机制，分析简化两线子系统“doublon”：backbone（bridge）强烈杂化连接端的两个Majorana模并使其偏离零能，而自由端模式形成近零能费米子。
AI.result: 在doublon中，存活MZM对的劈裂相比双侧tetron中的劈裂能量可下降约两个数量级，从而大幅增加宇称寿命。
AI.conclusion: 单侧tetron能实现与双侧tetron长度加倍相当的Majorana重叠抑制效果，有助于改善拓扑量子比特的相干性与操作性能。

title: Correlated Low-Energy Model of Monolayer 1H-NbS$_2$: A cRPA+DMFT Study
summary: Monolayer $1\mathrm{H}\text{-}\mathrm{NbS}_2$ hosts a well-separated metallic band of predominant Nb-$d_{z^2}$ character, providing an ideal platform to probe electronic correlations within a single-band setting. In this work, we present a comprehensive study of $1\mathrm{H}\text{-}\mathrm{NbS}_2$ by combining first-principles Wannier interpolation, constrained random-phase approximation (cRPA), and DFT+DMFT. We show that an effective single-band model accurately captures the low-energy electronic structure, reproducing key experimental features from ARPES and STS $dI/dV$ spectra, including a characteristic Van Hove singularity. While static DFT+$U$ fails to describe the correlated metallic nature of the system, DFT+DMFT successfully accounts for the spectral weight redistribution and dynamic correlations. By defining the cRPA target subspace directly within the isolated Nb-$d_{z^2}$ band, we obtain a renormalized local interaction of $U_{\mathrm{cRPA}} = 1.138~\mathrm{eV}$. This interaction stabilizes a strongly correlated metallic state that remains robust upon cooling. Remarkably, this minimal single-band model captures a spectral broadening similar to that previously reported in more elaborate treatments - incorporating larger local interactions ($U \sim 1.8~\mathrm{eV}$, derived from a multiorbital cRPA construction), intersite Coulomb terms ($V$), and electron-phonon coupling - demonstrating that a consistently downfolded local interaction alone can already capture key aspects of the experimentally observed low-energy behavior of monolayer $1\mathrm{H}\text{-}\mathrm{NbS}_2$.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理Wannier插值、cRPA与DFT+DMFT研究单层1H-NbS2，发现有效单带模型可准确描述低能电子结构与关联金属态。
AI.motivation: 单层1H-NbS2具有分离良好的、以Nb-dz2为主的金属带，是研究单带电子关联的理想平台，需要澄清其关联金属本质及最小模型能否捕捉实验特征。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理Wannier插值、约束随机相位近似(cRPA)与DFT+DMFT，并在孤立的Nb-dz2带内定义cRPA目标子空间，获得重整化局域相互作用U_cRPA=1.138 eV。
AI.result: 有效单带模型复现了ARPES和STS dI/dV谱的关键特征（含Van Hove奇异性）；静态DFT+U无法描述关联金属性，而DFT+DMFT成功再现谱权重新分布和动态关联，并在降温下稳定强关联金属态。该最小单带模型产生的谱展宽与更复杂处理（更大U~1.8 eV、V项及电声耦合）相似。
AI.conclusion: 一个一致下折叠的局域相互作用即可捕捉单层1H-NbS2实验观测低能行为的关键方面，无需更复杂多轨道或多体处理。

title: Time-Reversal Selection Rule for Twist Disorder
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, plus 61 pages of Supplemental Material with 19 figures
summary: Random layer rotations are ubiquitous in layered matter, from turbostratic films to rotationally disordered crystals, and strongly suppress transport across the layers. Generated by a symmetry operation, this disorder is absent on the rotation axis, so the thickness laws of conduction are set by how fast backscattering vanishes there. We show that a time-reversal selection rule decides this: each twist harmonic of the interlayer bond is either a frame rotation, whose backscattering cancels, or a coupling change, which scatters. A zero-set theorem turns the rule into universal thickness laws for electrons and phonons, fixed by band-edge symmetry; random twist increments rescale the backscattering but keep its order. Where the axis is unprotected, band nodes provide a second route: a transparent energy with heavy-tailed disorder and an $N^{-3}$ law. A first-principles forward-channel model of black phosphorus shows both routes; its random-twist films act as a symmetry filter that, relative to aligned stacks, retains a hundred times more of the electron than of the hole conductance at 64 layers. The symmetry of band edges and phonon branches thus decides what crosses a disordered stack, making stacking disorder a design element.

AI.tldr: 随机层扭转普遍存在于层状物质中并强烈抑制层间输运。作者提出时间反演选择定则决定背散射消失速度，并导出电子与声子的普适厚度定律，揭示堆垛无序可作为设计要素。
AI.motivation: 随机层旋转在层状材料中普遍存在且强烈抑制跨层输运；该无序由对称操作生成，在旋转轴上不存在，因此导电厚度定律由轴上背散射消失的快慢决定。作者希望理解并预测这一规律。
AI.method: 提出时间反演选择定则：层间键的每个扭转谐波要么是框架旋转(背散射抵消)，要么是耦合变化(产生散射)。用零集定理将选择定则转化为由带边对称性决定的电子与声子普适厚度定律。并建立黑磷的第一性原理前向通道模型。
AI.result: 随机扭转增量会重标背散射但保持其阶数。当轴不受保护时，能带节点提供第二条路径：透明能量、重尾无序与N^{-3}定律。黑磷模型同时显示两条路径：其随机扭转薄膜作为对称滤波器，在64层时相对对齐堆垛保留的电子电导比空穴电导多一百倍。
AI.conclusion: 带边与声子支的对称性决定了什么能穿越无序堆垛，使堆垛无序成为可设计的要素。

title: Accurate Molecular Property Regression Using Simple Fusion of Complementary Classical and Graph Predictors
summary: Accurate prediction of continuous molecular properties supports chemical discovery and design. Many recent approaches combine multiple molecular representations within increasingly complex neural architectures, aiming to achieve higher accuracy. However, classical machine-learning models remain competitive when trained on chemically meaningful molecular representations. We therefore constructed a chemistry-guided classical branch from Morgan fingerprints, RDKit molecular descriptors, and conformer-derived geometric features selected to provide complementary views of molecular structure. We combined four tree learners trained on these representations with a CoMPT graph predictor and integrated their out-of-fold predictions using Ridge regression. Across ESOL, FreeSolv, and Lipophilicity datasets, the fused model achieved lower mean root-mean-square error (RMSE) than Chemprop and competitive graph and multimodal methods, including CoMPT, MoleSG, KFLM2, and MCMPP. After retraining on the separately curated AqSolDB dataset, the same approach, without redesign or retuning, reduced mean absolute error (MAE) relative to the classical ensemble and achieved lower mean MAE than Chemprop. These results show that accurate and transferable molecular property regression does not necessarily require a complex joint multimodal architecture: classical learning remains competitive when chemical insight guides the choice of molecular representations, and a graph model can add complementary information through simple prediction-level fusion.

AI.tldr: 结合化学信息引导的经典机器学习(指纹/描述符/构象特征+树模型)与CoMPT图预测器，通过Ridge回归融合预测，在多个溶解度和亲脂性数据集上取得优于Chemprop等方法的精度，且可迁移至AqSolDB。
AI.motivation: 近年多数方法通过复杂神经架构整合多种分子表示以提升预测精度，但经典机器学习在化学上有意义的分子表示上仍具竞争力，作者希望验证准确且可迁移的分子性质回归是否真需要复杂的联合多模态架构。
AI.method: 构建化学引导的经典分支：Morgan指纹、RDKit描述符、构象衍生几何特征（提供互补结构视角），训练四个树学习器；与CoMPT图预测器结合，用Ridge回归在out-of-fold预测层面进行预测级融合。
AI.result: 在ESOL、FreeSolv、Lipophilicity数据集上，融合模型平均RMSE低于Chemprop，与CoMPT、MoleSG、KFLM2、MCMPP等图/多模态方法相当或更优；在AqSolDB上无需重新设计或调参直接重训练，MAE低于经典集成且平均MAE优于Chemprop。
AI.conclusion: 准确且可迁移的分子性质回归不必依赖复杂的联合多模态架构：化学洞见引导表示选择时经典学习仍有竞争力，图模型可通过简单的预测级融合提供互补信息。

title: Quantum geometry of collective pairing fluctuations in the superfluid weight of multiband superconductors
summary: Beyond the frozen-pairing contribution, the superfluid weight of a multiband superconductor contains a correction from the self-consistent relaxation of the pairing amplitudes under a phase twist. We show that this correction has a quantum-geometric origin, not in the space of Bloch states but in the space of collective pairing fields. For an attractive multiband Hubbard model at the mean-field level, the thermodynamic Hessian governing the pairing response coincides with the static Gaussian pair-fluctuation kernel at zero momentum at every temperature below $T_c$. Since gauge invariance relates a phase twist to a finite center-of-mass momentum of the pair field, the superfluid weight is set by the small-momentum curvature of the eigenvalue branch that evolves from the Goldstone mode, and the relaxation correction is a stiffness-weighted quantum metric of the corresponding soft eigenvector on the manifold of pairing configurations. The same construction yields the Ginzburg-Landau gradient coefficient with the identical geometric correction, hence the coherence-length tensor, and, with the low-frequency dynamics of the kernel, the pair-mass tensor. Lieb-lattice calculations verify the equivalence of the thermodynamic, fluctuation-kernel, and soft-mode formulations and the independence of the superfluid weight from the orbital embedding.

AI.tldr: 超流权重除"冻结配对"项外，还有配对幅值自洽弛豫修正，该修正具有量子几何起源——不在Bloch态空间而在集体配对场空间。
AI.motivation: 澄清多带超导体超流权重的弛豫修正来源，将其从传统Bloch态几何推广到配对场几何。
AI.method: 在平均场下研究吸引型多带Hubbard模型：证明热力学Hessian与零动量静态高斯配对涨落核在T_c以下处处相等；利用规范不变性将相位扭曲对应到配对场有限质心动量；由Goldstone模演化支的小动量曲率确定超流权重，并给出配对构型流形上软本征矢量的刚度加权量子度规。用Lieb晶格数值验证。
AI.result: 弛豫修正＝软模本征矢量的刚度加权量子度规；同一构造给出带相同几何修正的Ginzburg-Landau梯度系数（及相干长度张量），结合核的低频动力学还给出配对质量张量。Lieb晶格计算验证了热力学、涨落核与软模三种表述等价，且超流权重与轨道嵌入无关。
AI.conclusion: 配对场空间的量子几何统一描述了超流权重、相干长度张量与配对质量张量的几何修正，扩展了多带超导量子几何框架。

title: Constitutive-Set Mechanics: variational mechanics on an admissible set of constitutive laws
summary: A structural simulation needs a constitutive law, and experiments rarely determine one uniquely: several laws may fit the same data and satisfy the same physical constraints, yet differ where the structure is loaded in ways the tests never were. Constitutive-Set Mechanics (CSM) keeps all of those laws. It replaces the single law in the variational formulation by the admissible set, and lets the mechanics itself decide which members of the set affect the structural prediction. The framework rests on one observation: a finite element assembly consults the law only at the strains the structure reaches, so the incremental energy depends on the law through a weighted record of those strains, the occupation measure of the state. The energy of a state under the set is a support function on that measure, and the equilibrium solve one performs anyway supplies the information needed to bound the worst case. Equilibrium states become certificates on the robust response, rigorous on the upper side for any mechanics solver and two-sided under global minimisation; the certificate has at most one more state than the number of constitutive directions the structure interrogates; a coherence theorem identifies when the pointwise-worst material is one no single material can be; and constitutive inference acts on the same support function. The method is demonstrated on linear elasticity, a data-constrained constitutive function, phase-field fracture, an assembled finite-strain composite shell, and a membrane characterised by one-mode tests alone. On the shell the structure interrogates four of 226 constitutive directions; on the membrane the certified worst-case energy exceeds the reference more than fourfold, and the experiment that most contracts the certified prediction is not the one where the constitutive uncertainty is largest.

AI.tldr: 提出 Constitutive-Set Mechanics (CSM)：以本构律容许集替代单一律，用平衡解作为结构性鲁棒响应的证书。
AI.motivation: 结构仿真需要本构律，但实验难以唯一确定；多个律可拟合同一数据并满足物理约束，却在未测试的加载路径上分道扬镳。
AI.method: 保留全部容许律，在变分格式中用容许集替代单一本构律；关键观察是有限元装配只在结构达到的应变处查询本构律，故增量能量通过状态占据测度加权记录依赖该律。状态能量成为该测度上的支撑函数，常规平衡求解即提供最坏情况界所需信息。
AI.result: 平衡态成为鲁棒响应的证书：任意力学求解器下上侧严格，全局极小化下双侧；证书至多比结构查询的本构方向数多一个状态；相干性定理给出逐点最坏材料非单一材料的条件；本构推断作用于同一支撑函数。在多种算例中验证。
AI.conclusion: CSM 让力学自身决定容许集中哪些成员影响预测：复合材料壳仅侦测 226 个方向中的 4 个，膜的最坏能量超参考四倍以上，且最能收缩证书的实验并非本构不确定性最大者。

title: Phase diagram and transition properties of the Blume-Capel model: A Monte Carlo study
summary: The Jx-Jy Blume-Capel model, with and without an external magnetic field, is investigated using the Monte Carlo method. Our aim is to verify the location of the tricritical point, examine the existence of reentrant behavior, and study the magnetocaloric properties of this specifically designed system. In the non-field case, the critical temperature given by the Monte Carlo simulations is lower compared to the conventional antiferromagnetic square lattice. When an external magnetic field is applied, we observed signs of a one-dimensional spontaneous symmetry-breaking phase in the mixed-states regime, which is counterintuitive with secondary specific-heat peak. We take the snapshot of this state and elucidated the underlying mechanisms using mean field theory in the field of spin-1 spinor Bose-Einstein condensate . Regarding reentrant behavior, we confirmed its occurrence as the magnetic field varies, but only when the temperature is kept constant. Temperature-dependent reentrant behavior could not be identified within this system. Finally, we examined the magnetocaloric properties and found no evidence of first-order phase transitions within the region of the considered phase-transition point. Although both inverse and direct magnetocaloric effects are present and related to the mixed state, we identified that the relevant phase transitions are all of the second order.

AI.tldr: 本文用蒙特卡罗方法研究带/不带外磁场的 Jx-Jy Blume-Capel 模型，验证三临界点位置、重入行为及磁热性质。
AI.motivation: 验证 Jx-Jy Blume-Capel 模型的三临界点位置，考察重入行为是否存在，并研究该定制系统的磁热性质。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡罗模拟，并结合平均场理论（类比 spin-1 自旋玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）解释所观察到的混合态机制。
AI.result: 无场时临界温度低于常规反铁磁方阵；加场后在混合态区出现一维自发对称破缺相迹象并伴随次级比热峰；重入行为仅在固定温度下随磁场变化时出现，未发现温度依赖的重入；磁热方面未发现一阶相变，逆/正磁热效应均存在且与混合态相关，但相变均为二级。
AI.conclusion: 该系统的相关相变均为二阶，重入行为仅在磁场驱动（恒温）条件下成立。

title: Composite Fermion Theory of Fractional Chern Insulators in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: The experimental observation of the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect in rhombohedral graphene multilayers has raised questions about the nature of the fractional Chern insulator (FCI) states and the role of the moiré potential. In this Letter we develop a composite fermion (CF) description and discuss how moiré modulation and Coulomb interactions stabilize the FCI ground states. Under a flux-attachment transformation and mean-field approximation, the CF spectrum forms Landau levels that are further split by the moiré potential. At moiré filling fractions in the Jain sequence, an integer number of CF bands are occupied, resulting in an incompressible ground state with fractionally quantized Hall response. Remarkably, when the attached flux opposes the Berry curvature of the conduction band of rhombohedral graphene, the CF Landau levels are widely spaced in energy and delocalized across layers, leading to a reduced density of states that helps protect the CF mean-field state and amplifying effects of the moiré potential acting on the layer away from the doped electrons. Interactions between CFs further enlarge the moiré-induced band gap and stabilize the FCI ground state. Our work sheds light on the nature of the FCI states in rhombohedral graphene and provides a new theoretical framework for further studies.

AI.tldr: 本文用复合费米子(CF)理论解释菱方石墨烯多层中的分数陈绝缘体(FCI)态，指出摩尔势与库仑相互作用共同稳定FCI基态。
AI.motivation: 菱方石墨烯多层中分数量子反常霍尔效应的实验观测，引发了对FCI态本质及摩尔势作用的疑问。
AI.method: 发展复合费米子描述：通过磁通附着变换与平均场近似，CF谱形成朗道能级，并被摩尔势进一步劈裂。
AI.result: 在Jain序列的摩尔填充下，整数个CF能带被占据形成不可压缩基态并产生分数化量子化霍尔响应；当附着磁通与导带贝里曲率相反时，CF朗道能级间距大且层间离域，降低态密度以保护CF平均场态；CF间相互作用进一步增大摩尔诱导带隙。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了菱方石墨烯中FCI态的本质，并提供了新的理论框架。

title: Disorder into Correlation: A Microscopic Mechanism for Sub-McIntyre Avalanche Noise
summary: Avalanche multiplication is intrinsically stochastic, yet experiments reveal excess noise below the minimum predicted by McIntyre's local-field theory. The microscopic origin of this noise suppression remains incompletely understood. We show that polar-optical-phonon emission, confined to a narrow forward cone, competes with elastic alloy scattering that diffuses field-collimated hot carriers out of the cone. Suppressed phonon cooling narrows the ionization path beyond the dead space and synchronizes successive ionizations into a dynamic staircase. This explains the low noise of Sb-based alloys and HgCdTe and makes alloy disorder a design parameter.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示极性光学声子发射与弹性合金散射的竞争是雪崩倍增噪声低于McIntyre极限的微观起源，并提出合金无序可作为设计参数。
AI.motivation: 雪崩倍增本质上是随机的，但实验观测到的过剩噪声却低于McIntyre局域场理论预测的最小值，这一噪声抑制的微观机制此前尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 作者分析了极性光学声子发射（局限于一个狭窄的前向锥内）与弹性合金散射之间的竞争，后者会将场准直的热载流子扩散出该锥外。
AI.result: 受抑制的声子冷却使电离路径收窄至死区之外，并将连续的电离同步化为一种动态阶梯结构，从而解释了Sb基合金和HgCdTe的低噪声特性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了低噪声雪崩倍增的微观机制，并使合金无序成为一个可调控的设计参数。

title: Interplay between spinodal decomposition and wetting in ternary to quinary mixtures
summary: We use two-dimensional phase-field simulations based on the Cahn--Hilliard description to study spinodal decomposition in N-component mixtures with N = 3, 4, 5. In particular, we consider surface-directed spinodal decomposition in which one of the coexisting phases serves as a filler particle, while the remaining components phase separate around its surface. We investigate both nonwetting and wetting conditions by varying the interfacial tensions between the particle and the other components. The competition between wetting kinetics and spinodal decomposition produces rich morphological evolution, including the formation of lattice, droplet, and target (or core-shell) morphologies. The target pattern consists of alternating component-rich rings around the particle. In the intermediate-to-late time regime, these structures undergo further morphological transitions driven by curvature-induced depletion of wetting layers and subsequent coarsening of the surrounding domains, resulting in the breakup of target patterns into isolated domains of the matrix components. We find that domain coarsening slows down systematically as the number of components increases, while wetting accelerates it in all cases. The resulting morphologies and phase-separation pathways demonstrate how particle--component interactions can be used to control microstructural evolution in multicomponent mixtures, with potential implications for systems ranging from industrial materials to cellular biology.

AI.tldr: 该文用Cahn-Hilliard二维相场模拟研究N=3,4,5元混合物中表面导向旋节分解，发现润湿动力学与旋节分解竞争产生晶格、液滴、核壳等丰富形貌，并揭示其后期转变与粗化规律。
AI.motivation: 研究颗粒-组分相互作用如何调控多组分混合物中旋节分解的微观结构演化，并探索润湿条件与组分数对相分离路径和粗化动力学的影响。
AI.method: 基于Cahn-Hilliard方程的二维相场模拟，研究N=3,4,5元混合物中表面导向旋节分解；以共存相之一作为填充颗粒，通过改变颗粒与其他组分的界面张力考察非润湿与润湿条件。
AI.result: 润湿动力学与旋节分解的竞争产生晶格、液滴、核壳（靶状）等形貌；靶状结构由颗粒周围交替富集的组分环组成，中后期因曲率诱导的润湿层耗竭及周围畴粗化而破裂为孤立基体组分畴。组分增多使畴粗化系统性减慢，润湿则加速粗化。
AI.conclusion: 颗粒-组分相互作用可用于调控多组分混合物中的微结构演化，对工业材料到细胞生物学等体系具有潜在意义。

title: Learning consistent molecular mechanics force fields from first principles
comment: Accepted to the ML4Molecules Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Classical force fields (FFs) remain the workhorse for large-scale simulations even as machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approach ab initio accuracy. They decompose total configuration energies into simple effective interactions whose parameters are traditionally assigned based on atom or bond types, enabling efficient simulations but also limiting their ability to adapt across configurations. Recent machine learning approaches have improved the accuracy and transferability of bonded parameters in these FFs by inferring them as functions of local atomic environments, but still rely on empirical nonbonded parameters for practical simulations. In this work, we introduce a unified approach, \texttt{grappa-fullFF}, which learns both bonded and nonbonded parameters \emph{consistently} and simultaneously from ab initio reference data. By incorporating physically inspired regularization via supervision of the electrostatic potential and an architecture that facilitates charge equilibration, our model recovers accurate electric response properties, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on geometry optimization benchmarks, and reproduces the conformational sampling of both classical and existing machine-learned FFs, without relying on externally assigned nonbonded parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出 grappa-fullFF，统一从从头算数据中同时学习键合与非键合参数，无需外部经验非键合参数，达到几何优化最优精度并重现构象采样。
AI.motivation: 经典力场依赖原子/键类型分配参数，难以跨构型适应；近年ML方法虽提升键合参数精度，但非键合参数仍依赖经验赋值，限制实际模拟的准确性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出统一方法 grappa-fullFF，一致且同时地从从头算参考数据学习键合与非键合参数。通过静电势监督引入物理启发的正则化，并设计利于电荷平衡的架构。
AI.result: 恢复准确的电响应性质，在几何优化基准上达到最优精度；在无外部指定非键合参数的情况下，重现经典力场与已有机器学习力场的构象采样。
AI.conclusion: 统一学习键合与非键合参数可行且有效，为兼具高效率与高精度的力场建模提供了新途径。

title: Characteristics of extinction behavior of ammonia partial cracking simulated fuels in counterflow premixed flames under lean condition
summary: In this study, the lean extinction behaviors of CH4 and a 16% cracked ammonia surrogate fuel, CR16, in counterflow premixed flames were compared. Experiments were conducted along with one-dimensional simulations using OPPDIF; the GRI-Mech 3.0 and UCSD mechanisms were applied to CH4 and CR16, respectively. CR16 exhibited higher extinction strain rates and resilience to strain-induced blow-out (RSIB) than those of CH4 under lean conditions. At Phi = 0.66, although both flames had the same extinction strain rate, CR16 showed a higher RSIB because of its longer flame time. Near its extinction, CR16 sustained H2 consumption, radical reactions, and heat release through the interflame region toward the stagnation plane. Hydrogen oxidation coupled with nitrogen-related pathways, including NH2 + NO and HNO reactions, supported this behavior. These results clarify the chemical basis for the superior extinction resistance of economically favorable low-cracking-ratio ammonia fuel.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了CH4与16%裂解氨替代燃料CR16在贫燃预混对冲火焰中的熄火行为，发现CR16具有更高的熄火应变率和抗吹熄韧性。
AI.motivation: 探索经济上更优的低裂解比氨燃料（CR16）在贫燃条件下的熄火特性及其化学机理，并与CH4进行对比。
AI.method: 采用对冲预混火焰实验，结合OPPDIF一维模拟，CH4使用GRI-Mech 3.0机理，CR16使用UCSD机理。
AI.result: CR16在贫燃条件下熄火应变率和抗应变吹熄韧性均高于CH4；在Φ=0.66时两者熄火应变率相同，但CR16因火焰时间更长而具有更高的抗吹熄韧性。近熄火时CR16可通过火焰间区域向驻定面维持H2消耗、自由基反应和放热，H2氧化与NH2+NO、HNO等含氮路径耦合支撑该行为。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了低裂解比氨燃料优异抗熄火性能的化学基础，为其经济性应用提供依据。

title: Long-Range Nonequilibrium Correlations as a Thermodynamic Speedometer
summary: Despite purely local microscopic dynamics, nonequilibrium steady states can develop long-range correlations. We investigate this phenomenon in the boundary-driven symmetric simple exclusion process by relating its exact nonlocal large-deviation functional to finite-time thermodynamic irreversibility under weak time-dependent driving. Decomposing the long-range correlations into hydrodynamic modes, we find that the lag associated with the slowest mode satisfies an upper bound determined by the excess entropy production rate at each driving frequency. This bound is approached in the quasistatic limit, whereas progressively shorter-wavelength modes do not generally satisfy the corresponding bound. These results provide a quantitative connection between the curvature of the large-deviation functional, long-range correlations in the nonequilibrium steady state, and finite-time dissipation. Within the linear-response regime considered here, they indicate that the longest-wavelength hydrodynamic mode has a distinct relation between slow relaxation and thermodynamic irreversibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究边界驱动的对称简单排它过程，将其非局域大偏差泛函与弱时变驱动下的有限时间热力学不可逆性关联，揭示长程关联与耗散的关系。
AI.motivation: 非平衡稳态虽由纯局域微观动力学驱动，却能产生长程关联，理解这种关联与热力学不可逆性之间的定量联系是核心动机。
AI.method: 将精确的非局域大偏差泛函与弱时变驱动下的有限时间热力学不可逆性相联系，并把长程关联分解为流体力学模式进行分析。
AI.result: 最慢模式对应的滞后受每个驱动频率下超额熵产率决定的上界约束；该上界在准静态极限下可被逼近，而更短波长的模式一般不满足相应上界。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了大偏差泛函曲率、非平衡稳态长程关联与有限时间耗散之间的定量联系，表明最长波长流体力学模式在慢弛豫与热力学不可逆性之间具有独特关系。

title: Adjoint-State Identifiability of Piezo-Tunable Valley Splitting in 2D Magnetic Heterostructures
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables (including Supplementary Material). Custom adjoint-state codes and simulation dataset are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22850138
summary: Controlling valley degrees of freedom with mechanical strain is a promising approach for solid-state information processing. Current theoretical literature routinely predicts strain-tuned valley splitting at the microscopic level but rarely evaluates whether these quantum predictions remain statistically recoverable in realistic macroscopic devices. This manuscript establishes a fully classical, partial differential equation-constrained multiscale inverse framework for quantifying the device-level identifiability of predicted strain-tunable valley effects in two-dimensional magnetic heterostructures, demonstrated here for a molybdenum disulfide and chromium tribromide heterostructure. First-principles structural relaxations confirm a chiral $C_3$ point-group symmetry which mathematically reduces the relevant exchange-strain coupling tensor to a single scalar. A partial differential equation-constrained adjoint-state architecture successfully bridges continuum elastodynamics to valley-resolved anomalous Hall transport. Density functional theory yields a coupling estimate of $η\approx -0.07$ meV whose 95% confidence interval is consistent with zero. Evaluating this specific coupling magnitude against established thermal noise and velocity saturation limits defines a safe operating window bounded between 262.0 and 22,337.6 V/cm. Rather than asserting a confirmed nonzero material property this bounded operational window functions as a precise diagnostic threshold. Deploying this rigorous statistical identifiability framework provides a necessary mathematical filter to determine the true experimental viability of theoretically predicted two-dimensional materials before complex physical fabrication.

AI.tldr: 本文建立完全经典、PDE约束的多尺度逆框架，量化二维磁性异质结中应变可调能谷效应的器件级可辨识性，以MoS₂/CrBr₃为例。
AI.motivation: 现有理论常预测微观层面的应变能谷劈裂，但很少评估这些量子预测在真实宏观器件中是否具有统计可恢复性（可辨识性）。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理结构弛豫（确认手性C₃对称性，将交换-应变耦合张量约化为单标量）、DFT耦合估计、连续介质弹性动力学与能谷分辨反常霍尔输运，采用PDE约束的伴随态（adjoint-state）逆框架进行多尺度建模。
AI.result: DFT给出耦合η≈-0.07 meV，其95%置信区间与零一致；据此在热噪声与速度饱和约束下确定安全操作窗口为262.0–22,337.6 V/cm。
AI.conclusion: 该有界操作窗口不作为确证的非零材料属性，而作为精确的诊断阈值，为评估理论预测二维材料的实验可行性提供统计可辨识性的数学筛选工具。

title: Heavy-fermion hybridization waves from Dirac spinons near a Kondo-breakdown quantum phase transition
summary: Motivated by the recent observation of spatially modulated screening in different paramagnetic heavy-fermion materials, we propose a theoretical mechanism for the emergence of such hybridization waves in frustrated Kondo lattices with no magnetic order. By applying a parton mean-field theory and a perturbative calculation to a minimal Kondo-Heisenberg lattice model, we demonstrate that a heavy Fermi liquid can naturally develop hybridization waves when it approaches a quantum phase transition where Kondo screening breaks down and the local magnetic moments form a Dirac spin liquid. We relate the strength of this mechanism to a kinematic condition on the electronic and spinon band structures and show that the spatial periodicity of the hybridization wave is set by a momentum $\vec{Q}$ connecting the nodes in the dispersion of the Dirac spinons to low-energy portions of the electronic band structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在无磁序阻挫Kondo晶格中产生杂交波（hybridization waves）的理论机制，揭示重费米液体在接近Kondo屏蔽崩溃、局域磁矩形成Dirac自旋液体量子相变时，可自然发展出空间调制。
AI.motivation: 近期在不同顺磁重费米子材料中观测到空间调制的屏蔽现象，需要理论机制解释这类杂交波的起源，尤其是在无磁序的阻挫Kondo晶格中。
AI.method: 对最小Kondo-Heisenberg晶格模型应用parton平均场理论和微扰计算，分析重费米液体接近量子相变（Kondo屏蔽崩溃、Dirac自旋液体形成）时的行为。
AI.result: 证明重费米液体在接近该量子相变时可自然产生杂交波；其强度与电子和自旋子能带的运动学条件相关，且杂交波的空间周期由连接Dirac自旋子色散节点与电子能带低能部分的动量Q决定。
AI.conclusion: 为阻挫Kondo晶格中杂交波的出现提供了理论框架，将其与Dirac自旋液体量子相变及能带几何联系起来，可解释顺磁重费米子材料中的空间调制屏蔽现象。

title: CrystalJev: thinking fast and slow with atomistic foundation models for materials discovery
comment: 43 pages, 6 main figures, 5 Extended Data figures, 1 Extended Data table; Supplementary Information included
summary: Atomistic foundation models triage millions of hypothetical materials but are used as slow simulators, their thresholded energies taken at face value. They are better read as fast decision-makers. CrystalJev queries a frozen interatomic potential once per unrelaxed structure and answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities, finite-sample guarantees and a rule for when to think slowly. Across 65 Matbench Discovery models, a 'stable' call is a probability in disguise, explained by a model's errors and the candidate population. Once trained, one forward pass decides nearly as well as a relaxation at a thirtieth of its cost, and a value-of-information theory sends slower computation only where decisions can change. The same layer answers electronic, mechanical and molecular questions. In a registered prospective test with 700 new density-functional calculations, single-pass forecasts calibrated only on existing data over-stated the stable fraction of unseen candidates (5.8%) by at most 2.1 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 将原子基础模型从"慢速模拟器"重新定位为"快速决策器"：CrystalJev对未弛豫结构单次查询冻结势函数，输出带校准概率和有限样本保证的类型化答案，并用信息价值理论决定何时进行慢速计算。
AI.motivation: 现有原子基础模型虽能筛选海量假想材料，却被当作慢速模拟器使用，其阈值化能量被直接采信；实际上它们更适合被解读为快速决策器。
AI.method: CrystalJev对每个未弛豫结构只查询一次冻结的原子间势，给出带校准概率、有限样本保证和"何时慢想"规则的答案；通过信息价值理论将更慢的计算仅导向决策可能改变之处；同一层可回答电子、力学和分子问题。
AI.result: 在65个Matbench Discovery模型上，"稳定"判断实为一种概率，可由模型误差和候选总体解释；一次前向传播的决策效果几乎等同一次弛豫，成本仅为其1/30；在含700个新DFT计算的注册前瞻测试中，仅用既有数据校准的单次预测高估未见候选稳定比例（5.8%）至多2.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 原子基础模型应作为具校准概率与样本保证的快速决策器使用，单次前向传播即可接近弛豫级决策质量并大幅降低成本，且校准预测在真实前瞻测试中误差可控。

title: Identifying Plastic Inorganic Semiconductors Requires More Rigorous Criteria
summary: The identification of plastic inorganic semiconductors becomes challenging when their mechanical responses depend on crystallographic orientation, sample size, and loading conditions. Using layered GeSe as a model system, we examine its deformation behavior through macroscopic compression, bending, conventional micropillar compression, and eccentric micropillar compression. Under macroscopic compression perpendicular to the layers, GeSe sustains approximately 23% strain without fracture, whereas bending along the c-axis armchair direction produces brittle cleavage fracture. Conventional micropillar compression results in brittle fragmentation, while eccentric loading introduces a shear component that activates pronounced interlayer sliding and accommodates deformation. These contrasting responses reflect the coupled effects of bonding topology, interlayer van der Waals interactions, defect density, stress constraints, and strain path on the competition between sliding and fracture. The results highlight the limitations of identifying plasticity from a single direction, scale, or test and support a systematic evaluation framework combining multiple directions, length scales, loading modes, and characterization techniques. More rigorous and unified criteria are needed to guide reliable materials selection for flexible electronics and devices integrated on curved surfaces.

AI.tldr: 以层状GeSe为模型，结合宏观压缩、弯曲、常规与偏心微柱压缩，揭示其塑性/脆性响应强烈依赖取向、尺寸与加载方式，强调需建立多方向、多尺度、多模式的统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 无机塑性半导体的力学响应受晶体取向、样品尺寸和加载条件影响，仅凭单一方向、尺度或测试判断其塑性存在局限，需要更可靠的评估标准以指导柔性电子与曲面器件选材。
AI.method: 以层状GeSe为模型体系，开展宏观压缩、弯曲、常规微柱压缩及偏心微柱压缩实验，对比不同加载条件下的变形与断裂行为。
AI.result: 垂直层向宏观压缩可持续约23%应变而不断裂；沿c轴扶手椅方向弯曲发生脆性解理断裂；常规微柱压缩表现为脆性碎裂；偏心加载引入剪切分量，激活显著层间滑移并协调变形。
AI.conclusion: GeSe的滑移与断裂竞争受键合拓扑、层间范德华作用、缺陷密度、应力约束和应变路径耦合影响；需采用涵盖多方向、多尺度、多加载模式与多表征技术的系统评估框架，并建立更严格统一的判据来指导柔性电子材料选择。

title: A pressure-based coupled general synthetic iterative scheme for rarefied gas flow simulation
summary: This work develops a pressure-based coupled (PBC) GSIS. Within each GSIS iteration, a conventional kinetic solver advances the velocity distribution function, from which non-equilibrium constitutive relations are extracted. A PBC macroscopic solver then solves the steady macroscopic synthetic equations: continuity and momentum equations are solved as a coupled pressure-velocity system under fixed temperature, followed by a segregated temperature solve. A boundary treatment is constructed to maintain strict consistency between kinetic boundary fluxes and macroscopic boundary conditions throughout the macroscopic iterations. The proposed method is validated against direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) data across multiple three-dimensional test cases, including tube-to-vacuum flows, a dynamic gas lock configuration for EUV lithography, divertors in nuclear fusion, and sphere flow at Mach numbers up to 10. Numerical results demonstrate that our GSIS-PBC preserves asymptotic-preserving properties and yields satisfactory accuracy across continuum-to-transitional flow regimes. For low-speed near-continuum internal flows, GSIS-PBC delivers wall clock time speed-ups of up to two orders of magnitude compared with the conventional iterative scheme, and substantially outperforms the original density-based GSIS for challenging low-Mach internal flow problems. For nuclear-fusion divertor flows, GSIS-PBC is faster than the DSMC by four orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于压力的耦合GSIS（PBC-GSIS）方法，用于跨流区的稀薄气体流动模拟。
AI.motivation: 传统GSIS在低速近连续、低马赫内流等问题上效率不足，需要更高效的宏观-动理学耦合求解方案。
AI.method: 每次GSIS迭代中，动理学求解器推进速度分布函数并提取非平衡本构关系；随后PBC宏观求解器求解稳态宏观合成方程，连续性方程与动量方程以压力-速度耦合系统在固定温度下求解，再分离求解温度；并构造边界处理保证动理学边界通量与宏观边界条件严格一致。
AI.result: 与DSMC对比，在管-真空流、EUV光刻动态气锁、核聚变偏滤器及马赫数达10的球体绕流等三维算例中保持渐近保持性质，跨连续-过渡流区精度满意；低速近连续内流加速达两个数量级，优于原密度基GSIS；偏滤器流中比DSMC快四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: PBC-GSIS是一种高效、准确且具有渐近保持性的方法，适用于连续至过渡流区的三维稀薄气体流动模拟。

title: Heterogeneous diffusion with recruitment and mortality
summary: We study a heterogeneous diffusion process with a position-dependent diffusion coefficient in the presence of independent recruitment and mortality. This framework generalises heterogeneous diffusion under stochastic resetting, which is recovered as the special case of equal recruitment and mortality rates. At long times, the system approaches a non-equilibrium stationary state with a mean squared displacement that saturates to a value independent of the recruitment rate. Crucially, this saturation limit directly encodes the underlying transport regime via an effective exponent applied to the diffusion coefficient, and we characterise the non-trivial transition to this stationary regime. We further derive the mean first-passage time to a target and show that, for a fixed recruitment-to-mortality ratio, an optimal mortality rate minimises the search time. This "mortality-assisted search" effect is confirmed by numerical evaluation. Reinterpreting recruitment and mortality as infection and removal processes, we apply the model to epidemic spreading and show that a moderate removal rate can counter-intuitively accelerate, rather than delay, the arrival of infection at a new spatial region. Beyond epidemiology, our framework offers broad relevance to systems featuring concurrent particle creation and destruction, such as bacterial growth, tracer diffusion in reactive fluids, or cellular population dynamics in crowded environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有随位置变化扩散系数、并包含独立招募（粒子产生）与死亡过程的异质扩散模型，揭示了长时间下非平衡稳态的性质，以及"死亡辅助搜索"和疫情传播加速等反直觉效应。
AI.motivation: 随机重置下的异质扩散已被广泛研究，但招募与死亡率不相等的一般情形（即同时存在粒子产生与消亡）尚缺乏系统分析，而这类过程广泛存在于细菌生长、反应流体示踪、细胞群体动力学等场景中。
AI.method: 构建含位置依赖扩散系数、独立招募率与死亡率的异质扩散过程；解析求解长时间稳态行为与均方位移，并推导至目标点的平均首次通过时间。
AI.result: 长时间下系统趋于非平衡稳态，均方位移饱和至与招募率无关的值，且该饱和极限通过作用于扩散系数的有效指数直接编码输运机制；首次通过时间分析表明，在固定招募-死亡率比下存在最优死亡率使搜索时间最短（数值验证）；应用于疫情传播时，中等移除率可加速而非延迟感染到达新区域。
AI.conclusion: 招募-死亡框架统一并推广了重置下异质扩散，饱和极限可表征输运机制，且存在"死亡辅助搜索"最优效应；该框架对细菌生长、反应流体示踪和细胞群体动力学等含粒子产生与消亡的系统具有广泛适用性。

title: Contact-Governed Macroscopic Signatures of Strain-Induced Valley Sorting in MoS$_2$ Field-Effect Transistors
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Custom SILVACO TCAD scripts, COMSOL files and datasets are all available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21346193
summary: Strain engineering is a leading route to control valley-selective transport in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. Whether this quantum effect survives inside a fully contacted device remains an open question. Quantum transport models capture the underlying valley deflection but are limited to isolated nanoscale fragments, leaving it unclear if a full device registers strain-induced valley sorting in the bulk, at the contacts, or at all. Here, the quantum valley-deflection tensor of strained monolayer MoS$_2$ is embedded directly into a macroscopic Poisson-drift-diffusion model, extending this physics to a complete, contact-inclusive device. Applying this framework to a 300~nm monolayer MoS$_2$ transistor with a 3~nm HfO$_2$ gate dielectric at 77~K, under a localized 6.14~T pseudo-magnetic strain field, shows the resulting 63.6\% suppression of the ON-state current is not a bulk property. It is set almost entirely by the source and drain metal-semiconductor interfaces. The full suppression is reproduced when only the 15~nm contact regions are strained and nearly vanishes when the channel interior alone is strained, identifying the metal contact as the dominant site of strain-induced valley physics. Observing it requires tunneling-transparent, degenerately-doped contacts, since classical Ohmic barriers overwhelm the topological signal. A transmission-line analysis reduces this behavior to a single valley-topological contact resistance ($R_{c,V}$) and a predictive inverse-length scaling law. This framework applies to any strain-engineered 2D-material heterostructure and can be tested with standard multi-length contact structures. Ultimately, these results identify the metal-semiconductor interface as the decisive location for engineering and detecting valley-selective transport in real 2D-material devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将应变单层MoS₂的量子谷偏转张量嵌入宏观Poisson-漂移-扩散模型，构建含接触的完整器件模拟框架，发现应变诱导的谷选择性输运主要由源漏金属-半导体界面决定，而非沟道体内。
AI.motivation: 应变工程是控制单层过渡金属硫族化物谷选择性输运的重要途径，但该量子效应能否在含完整接触的实际器件中存活尚不清楚。现有量子输运模型仅局限于孤立的纳米尺度片段，无法判定完整器件中应变诱导谷分选发生在体内、接触处还是根本不发生。
AI.method: 将应变单层MoS₂的量子谷偏转张量直接嵌入宏观Poisson-漂移-扩散模型，把该物理拓展到含接触的完整器件。应用于300 nm单层MoS₂晶体管（3 nm HfO₂栅介质，77 K，6.14 T局域赝磁场应变场），并通过传输线分析将其归结为单一谷拓扑接触电阻R_{c,V}及预测性反比长度标度律。
AI.result: ON态电流被抑制63.6%，但该抑制并非体材料属性，几乎完全由源漏金属-半导体界面决定：仅对15 nm接触区施加应变即可复现全部抑制，仅对沟道内部施加应变则抑制几乎消失。观测该效应需要隧穿透明、简并掺杂的接触，否则经典欧姆势垒会淹没拓扑信号。
AI.conclusion: 金属-半导体界面是实际2D材料器件中工程化与探测谷选择性输运的决定性位置。该框架适用于任何应变工程化的2D材料异质结，并可用标准多长度接触结构进行验证。

title: Chiral Parafermions in Floquet $\mathbb{Z}_N$ Topological Order
summary: Floquet topological order (FTO) extends topology beyond equilibrium, giving rise to phenomena, such as the dynamical transmutation of anyons. Here, we realize $\mathbb{Z}_N$ FTO in a generalized Kitaev honeycomb model with clock degrees of freedom using a three-step periodic drive. The driven system admits an emergent description in terms of constrained parafermions coupled to conserved $\mathbb{Z}_N$ gauge fields. At the boundary, the drive generates chiral parafermionic Floquet edge modes. We resolve their propagation through correlation functions, characterize their fractional quantum-information transport through the radical chiral unitary index, and use their dynamics to probe exchange statistics. In the bulk, we explore the dynamical anyon transmutation with a non-equilibrium loop order parameter. At a Floquet sweet spot, where the drive becomes Clifford, these phenomena can be accessed using stabilizer simulations. Short-time matrix-product-state simulations away from this point show that the chiral edge response persists at accessible times. Our results establish $\mathbb{Z}_N$ Kitaev models as a setting for exploring intrinsically non-equilibrium topological phenomena on qudit-based quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义Kitaev蜂窝模型（含clock自由度）中，用三步周期驱动实现Z_N Floquet拓扑序，揭示边缘手性parafermion模、分数量子信息输运及体态任意子动态嬗变。
AI.motivation: Floquet拓扑序将拓扑推广至非平衡态，可产生任意子动态嬗变等现象；本文旨在实现Z_N FTO并探索其非平衡拓扑现象。
AI.method: 在含clock自由度的广义Kitaev蜂窝模型上施加三步周期驱动，用受限parafermion与守恒Z_N规范场描述；通过关联函数解析边缘模传播，用radical手性幺正指数刻画分数量子信息输运，并探测交换统计；体态用非平衡loop序参量研究动态任意子嬗变；在Floquet sweet spot（驱动变为Clifford）用stabilizer模拟，离该点用短时MPS模拟。
AI.result: 驱动产生手性parafermionic Floquet边缘模，展现出分数量子信息输运与交换统计；体态观察到动态任意子嬗变；Floquet sweet spot可用stabilizer模拟，远离该点时手性边缘响应在可及时间内持续存在。
AI.conclusion: Z_N Kitaev模型可作为在qudit量子处理器上探索内禀非平衡拓扑现象的平台。

title: Direct-Write Chemical Vapor Deposition
summary: Direct-write pattering, using chemical vapor deposition through a nozzle, enables localized film growth using high-purity precursors standard to the electronics industry. Yet, achieving sub 100 $μ\mathrm{m}$ feature control has been limited by nozzle design and unquantified precursor surface diffusion. Here, we report a direct-write chemical vapor deposition platform that employs a 10 $μ\mathrm{m}$ tip diameter glass micro-nozzle mounted on a scanning stage above a heated substrate in ultra-high vacuum. Using this approach, we demonstrate the continuous single-pass writing of 500 $\mathrm{nm}$ thick metallic aluminum lines with a 30 $μ\mathrm{m}$ linewidth on titanium nitride-coated silicon. This capability enables maskless, localized growth under systematically varied deposition conditions on a single substrate. To analyze the resulting deposit profiles, we introduce a transport framework coupling Knudsen gas emission from the micro-nozzle with surface diffusion to extract the effective precursor diffusion length, $L_d$. $L_d$ captures the combined impact of precursor surface mobility, residence time, substrate temperature ($165^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ to $205^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$), growth duration, and nozzle height, contracting from 17.4 $μ\mathrm{m}$ down to 3.2 $μ\mathrm{m}$ at elevated temperatures. These results establish $L_d$ as a quantitative parameter for evaluating laterally confined chemical vapor growth and predicting feature resolution limits. This approach provides a practical methodology to measure and quantify precursor surface transport in localized film synthesis.

AI.tldr: 报道一种直写化学气相沉积平台，用10 μm微喷嘴在UHV中单次直写30 μm宽、500 nm厚铝线，并建立气体发射+表面扩散模型提取有效前驱体扩散长度Ld。
AI.motivation: 直写CVD受喷嘴设计和未量化的前驱体表面扩散限制，难以实现亚100 μm特征控制，缺乏定量描述表面传输的参数。
AI.method: 10 μm尖径玻璃微喷嘴+扫描台，置于加热基底上方、超高真空环境；通过改变沉积条件在同基底上局域生长；用Knudsen气体发射耦合表面扩散的输运框架拟合沉积轮廓，提取有效扩散长度Ld。
AI.result: 单次连续直写TiN/Si上500 nm厚、30 μm线宽金属铝线；Ld随温度（165–205 °C）等条件从17.4 μm收缩至3.2 μm。
AI.conclusion: Ld可作为定量参数评估横向受限CVD生长并预测特征分辨率极限，为局域薄膜合成中前驱体表面传输的测量与量化提供实用方法。

title: Neural-Operator-Predicted Time-Dependent Reduced Subspaces for Projection-Based Simulation of Nonlinear PDEs
summary:
Accurate numerical simulation of nonlinear partial differential equation initial value problems typically requires high-dimensional full-order discretizations at substantial computational cost. While purely data-driven surrogates can speed up prediction, these "black box" approximations do not necessarily satisfy the governing equations during inference. In this paper we present a hybrid framework, which combines neural operators with projection-based reduced-order modeling for nonlinear PDE simulation. The key idea is to train a neural operator to map the initial condition to a time-dependent reduced subspace, and then evolve low-dimensional reduced coordinates by solving the governing dynamical equations projected on this learned moving trial subspace. In this way, the network predicts an adaptive reduced representation rather than the full trajectory directly, while the online solver preserves a physics-based reduced evolution.
  We test this method on two representative nonlinear PDEs: the viscous Burgers' equation and the Fisher--KPP reaction--diffusion equation. In both cases, the proposed approach achieves successful reduced-order simulation with substantial wall-clock speedup relative to the corresponding full-order solver while maintaining relative errors on the order of \(10^{-2}\) to \(10^{-1}\) across the tested resolutions. These results demonstrate that a low-dimensional learned time-dependent reduced subspace can be used to predict solutions to nonlinear PDEs while retaining the advantages of projection-based reduced dynamics. Overall, this method provides a promising framework for fast and physically grounded data-assisted simulation of nonlinear PDEs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合框架，将神经算子与基于投影的降阶建模结合，用于非线性PDE仿真：神经网络预测随时间变化的降阶子空间，在线求解器在该子空间上投影演化控制方程。
AI.motivation: 非线性PDE初值问题的精确数值仿真需要高维全阶离散，计算成本高；纯数据驱动的代理模型虽快，但作为"黑箱"近似在推理时不满足控制方程。
AI.method: 训练神经算子将初始条件映射为时间相关的降阶子空间，然后通过求解投影到该学习得到的移动试验子空间上的控制动力学方程，来演化低维降阶坐标。
AI.result: 在粘性Burgers方程和Fisher-KPP反应扩散方程上测试，均实现成功的降阶仿真，相比全阶求解器获得显著墙钟加速，相对误差保持在10^-2至10^-1量级。
AI.conclusion: 低维学习的时间相关降阶子空间可用于预测非线性PDE解，同时保留基于投影的降阶动力学优势，为快速且具有物理基础的数据辅助仿真提供了有前景的框架。

title: Spatial density, first passage times, and entropy of run and tumble particles in a bistable potential
summary: We study the dynamics of a run and tumble particle (RTP) in a bistable potential, in contact with a heat bath. We find the exact form of the steady state position distribution as well as its time-dependent form in Laplace space. We use this result to study relaxation properties of the spatial probability density and find that it converges to the steady state from the center outwards, with the relaxation front moving ballistically in time. Physically this ballistic behavior arises when observing relaxation properties at the tails of the density, where the distance of the particle from the origin is larger than the length-scale describing the steady state of the RTP. We also find the exact form of the mean first passage time, and the long-time behavior of the first passage time distribution. This allows us to coarse-grain the dynamics as a dichotomous Markov process, a paradigm for a wide class of bistable processes. Coarse-graining, however, comes at the cost of a loss of information: while the RTP possesses a finite entropy production even at steady state, it identically vanishes for its coarse-grained description.

AI.tldr: 研究双稳态势中run and tumble粒子的动力学，求解稳态位置分布、弛豫行为、首次通过时间，并粗粒化为二态马尔可夫过程。
AI.motivation: 理解活性粒子（RTP）在双稳态势中的非平衡弛豫与粗粒化描述之间的关系。
AI.method: 求稳态位置分布精确解及其在Laplace空间的时间依赖形式，分析弛豫性质、平均首次通过时间与首次通过时间分布的长时行为，并将动力学粗粒化为二态马尔可夫过程。
AI.result: 弛豫从中心向外收敛，弛豫前沿随时间弹道式移动；此行为出现在密度尾部、粒子距原点大于RTP稳态长度尺度时。得到平均首次通过时间精确解及首次通过时间分布长时行为。
AI.conclusion: RTP即使稳态也具有限熵产生，但其粗粒化描述中熵产生恒为零，说明粗粒化会损失信息。

title: Theory of resonance Raman profiles in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers: Interference effects due to inter-valley phonon scattering
summary: The optical properties of monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are strongly impacted by exciton-phonon coupling, especially inter-valley scattering in the case of tungsten-based materials. Together with strain-tunability of the energetic K-Q valley separation this material class therefore provides a platform for semiconductor optomechanics. Here we investigate the influence of inter-valley scattering and strain on resonance Raman scattering in monolayer TMDCs using a microscopic model based on an effective deformation potential coupling for the exciton-phonon interaction. Considering exemplarily the resonance Raman profile of the A$_1$-mode in hBN-encapsulated monolayer WSe$_2$, we find that inter-valley scattering between the electronic K- and Q-valley leads to destructive interference between a first order and a third order Raman process. As a result we obtain a suppression of the incoming resonance in WSe$_2$, consistent with recently published experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文建立微观模型研究单层TMDC中谷间散射与应变对共振拉曼散射的影响，发现K-Q谷间散射引起的相消干涉导致WSe2中入射共振被抑制。
AI.motivation: 单层TMDC光学性质强烈受激子-声子耦合（尤其钨基材料的谷间散射）影响，且K-Q谷能量间距可受应变调控，使其成为半导体光机械平台的理想候选，因此需理解谷间散射与应变如何影响共振拉曼散射。
AI.method: 基于激子-声子相互作用的有效形变势耦合建立微观模型，以hBN封装的单层WSe2中A1模式的共振拉曼谱为示例进行研究。
AI.result: 电子K谷与Q谷之间的谷间散射导致一阶与三阶拉曼过程发生相消干涉，从而在WSe2中产生对入射共振的抑制，与近期实验数据一致。
AI.conclusion: 谷间散射引起的拉曼过程相消干涉可解释WSe2中共振拉曼谱的入射共振抑制，为TMDC光机械应用提供理论支撑。

title: Local-moment magnets on all close-packed lattices are equivalent
summary: The Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the fcc lattice is a canonical example of frustration. The fcc lattice is but one of an infinite number of close-packed structures, all of which have the same frustration-inducing local geometry. In this letter, we demonstrate a hidden symmetry that relates classical magnets on all close-packed lattices. This symmetry derives from a similar property in tight binding models that may explain the disordered low-temperature structures of lithium and sodium metals. In magnets, the symmetry holds when couplings are restricted to nearest ($J_1$) and next-nearest neighbours ($J_2$). It guarantees that all close-packed lattices are equivalent at the Luttinger-Tisza level. For any given values of $J_1$ and $J_2$, they have the same ground-state energy. Their ground state momenta are identical when projected onto the stacking plane. We construct a unified phase diagram as a function of $J_1$ and $J_2$ couplings for Heisenberg, XY and Ising magnets on any close-packed lattice. In each phase, the ground-state degeneracy is the same on all close-packed lattices, even after accounting for multi-Q spirals. This phase diagram can be easily adapted to any magnet composed of stacked triangular layers with similar couplings. Fluctuations above the classical ground state(s) are not related by any symmetry. This suggests that close-packed structures can show interesting differences in order-by-disorder selection.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了所有密堆积晶格上经典磁体（受J1-J2耦合）之间存在隐藏对称性，使其在Luttinger-Tisza层面等价，并构建统一相图。
AI.motivation: FCC海森堡反铁磁体是阻挫的典型例子，而FCC只是无穷多具有相同阻挫局域几何的密堆积结构之一。作者希望找到一个能统一描述所有密堆积晶格磁体的隐藏对称性，以简化对这一大族结构的研究。
AI.method: 作者从紧束缚模型中的类似性质出发，提出关联所有密堆积晶格经典磁体的隐藏对称性；该对称性在仅考虑最近邻(J1)和次近邻(J2)耦合时成立，并利用Luttinger-Tisza方法分析基态能量、动量及相图。
AI.result: 该对称性保证所有密堆积晶格在Luttinger-Tisza层面等价：给定J1、J2时基态能量相同，投影到堆叠平面上的基态动量也一致；作者据此构建了适用于任何密堆积晶格的Heisenberg、XY和Ising磁体统一相图，各相基态简并度在所有密堆积晶格上相同（即使考虑多Q螺旋）。
AI.conclusion: 该相图可方便地推广到任意由相似耦合的堆叠三角层构成的磁体。由于经典基态之上的涨落不受该对称性约束，密堆积结构可能在序中有序选择上展现出有趣的差异。

title: Layered spin-crossover metal-organic frameworks for light-induced control of two-dimensional quantum materials
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are widely explored for gas separation, catalysis or energy storage, yet their integration with other electronically functional materials remains largely unexplored. Here, we integrate the layered Hofmann-type spin-crossover (SCO) MOF {FeII(pyS2Et)2[PtII(CN)4]} into electrical nanodevices to control the properties of two-dimensional (2D) quantum materials. Our molecular approach exploits the stimuli-responsive nature of SCO layered materials as switchable building blocks. We demonstrate selective modulation of the electronic transport in van der Waals heterostructures interfacing SCO with 2D quantum materials (few-layer graphene, magnetic CrSBr, superconducting NbSe2) through the strain induced via thermal and light-induced spin transitions. In graphene, the conductivity is selectively switched by light. In spin-valves based on CrSBr bilayers, the MOF triggers magnetic hysteresis (absent in pristine CrSBr) and enables tunable non-volatile zero-field memory. In NbSe2, light modulates the superconducting critical current and transition temperature. These results establish layered stimuli-responsive SCO MOFs as active molecular control elements for 2D quantum materials, providing a route to strain-mediated control of electronic, magnetic, and superconducting functionalities and extending MOF-based architectures beyond traditional porous-matter applications towards multifunctional electronics and spintronics.

AI.tldr: 将层状 Hofmann 型自旋交叉(SCO) MOF 集成到电学纳米器件中，通过热/光诱导自旋转变产生的应变，实现对石墨烯、CrSBr 和 NbSe₂ 等二维量子材料的电学、磁性和超导性质的调控。
AI.motivation: MOF 广泛应用于气体分离、催化、储能等，但其与电子功能材料的集成仍鲜有探索。作者希望利用 SCO 层状材料的刺激响应性，将其作为可切换的构建单元，拓展 MOF 在多功能电子学与自旋电子学中的应用。
AI.method: 将层状 Hofmann 型 SCO MOF {FeII(pyS2Et)2[PtII(CN)4]} 与二维量子材料（少层石墨烯、磁性 CrSBr、超导 NbSe₂）构建范德华异质结，通过热和光诱导的自旋转变产生应变，从而调控界面电子输运。
AI.result: 石墨烯中电导可被光选择性切换；基于 CrSBr 双层的自旋阀中，MOF 触发原本不存在的磁滞，实现可调的非易失零场存储；NbSe₂ 中光可调控超导临界电流和转变温度。
AI.conclusion: 层状刺激响应 SCO MOF 可作为二维量子材料的活性分子控制元件，实现应变介导的电子、磁性和超导功能调控，将 MOF 架构从传统多孔材料应用拓展至多功能电子学与自旋电子学。

title: Closed analytical form of many-body free volume and thermodynamics of monodisperse hard disks
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, to be published in J. Chem. Phys
summary: The hard disk model is a fundamental reference system for excluded volume physics, liquid structure, and 2D ordering. Yet, despite its apparent simplicity, an analytical formulation of its thermodynamics has remained difficult because the free volume available to disks centers has a highly nontrivial many-body geometry. Here we show that this geometry admits a closed and exact representation: for any given hard disk configuration, the free volume can be analytically expressed through intersection areas of up to five exclusion disks. This provides a direct geometrical route from particle coordinates to the configurational partition function and entropy. We prove that the N disk partition function factorizes into a product of conditional free volumes and identify its two limiting asymptotic forms: the low density fluid regime controlled by extensive cavities and the high density fluid regime controlled by intensive private cells. Using the geometric measures computed from representative equilibrium particle configurations, the resulting theory reproduces the established hard disk equation of state over almost the entire density range up to close packing. At intermediate densities, the analysis reveals a mixed fluid regime in which localized caged defects provide an additional configurational entropy within the density interval preceding liquid hexatic coexistence. Finally, the five disk intersection area is shown to be a sensitive local scalar measure of hexagonal ordering, complementing the orientational order parameter and emphasizing the central role of many-body correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了硬盘模型自由体积的精确解析表示，证明N盘配分函数可分解为条件自由体积之积，并据此重构了几乎整个密度范围的物态方程。
AI.motivation: 硬盘模型是排除体积物理、液体结构与二维有序化的基础参照系统，但其自由体积具有高度非平凡的少体几何，导致热力学缺乏解析表述。
AI.method: 将任意硬盘构型的自由体积精确表示为至多五个排除圆交叠面积的组合；证明N盘配分函数分解为条件自由体积之积，并识别低密度（广延空腔控制）与高密度（私有胞元控制）两种渐近极限；利用代表性平衡构型计算几何量。
AI.result: 该理论在几乎整个密度范围直至密堆积再现了已知的硬盘物态方程；在中等密度揭示出混合流体区，其中局域笼状缺陷在液-六角共存前提供额外构型熵；五圆交叠面积可作为六角有序的敏感局域标量度量，补充取向序参量。
AI.conclusion: 硬盘自由体积的闭合精确几何表示打通了从粒子坐标到配分函数与熵的直接路径，凸显多体关联在二维有序化中的核心作用。

title: Direct synthesis of moiré graphene with twist-tuned hybridization
summary: Twisted van der Waals (vdW) systems provide a powerful platform for exploring emergent correlated phenomena, including superconductivity, magnetism, and topological phases. The twist angle offers a continuous tuning parameter for modifying the underlying Hamiltonian, however, precise and reproducible control remains challenging. Existing approaches are limited by single-use device architectures, restricted angular precision, or vertical probing geometries. Here we introduce a reconfigurable graphene-based moiré platform in which two independently fabricated layers are mechanically assembled and rotated in situ using a micro-electromechanical system (MEMS). Raman spectroscopy confirms the formation and robustness of the twist-induced moiré potential and enables continuous, deterministic control of the twist angle. The moiré potential folds the electronic band structure and activates the longitudinal optical (LO) phonon mode, allowing us to map its dispersion and directly visualize the moiré momentum. Angle-dependent electronic band hybridization is resolved through the evolution of the double-resonant 2D mode. Near \(0^\circ\), an emergent asymmetry of the \(Γ\)-point G-mode phonon reveals phonon band folding and hybridization driven by the moiré superlattice potential and interlayer relaxation. Our platform provides a reproducible Raman reference for twisted bilayer graphene while eliminating device-to-device variability. More broadly, it establishes the twist angle as a deterministically controllable parameter for systematic studies of correlated and topological phenomena in moiré quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于MEMS的可重构石墨烯莫尔平台，将两层独立制备的样品原位机械组装并旋转，实现连续、确定性的扭转角控制，并用拉曼光谱研究莫尔势与电子/声子行为。
AI.motivation: 扭转vdW体系可探索超导、磁性与拓扑等关联现象，扭转角是连续调节参数，但现有方法受限于一次性器件架构、角度精度不足或垂直探测几何，难以精确可复现控制。
AI.method: 用MEMS原位旋转两块独立制备的石墨烯层构成可重构莫尔平台；通过拉曼光谱确认扭转诱导莫尔势的形成与稳健性，实现连续确定性角度调控，并探测LO声子色散、莫尔动量、2D模的双共振演化及Γ点G模声子不对称性。
AI.result: 拉曼光谱证实莫尔势形成且稳健；莫尔势折叠能带并激活LO声子模，可映射其色散并直接可视化莫尔动量；角度依赖的能带杂化由双共振2D模演化体现；近0°时Γ点G模声子出现不对称，揭示莫尔超晶格势与层间弛豫导致的声子带折叠与杂化。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为扭转双层石墨烯提供可复现的拉曼参考，消除器件间差异，并将扭转角确立为确定性可控参数，便于系统研究莫尔量子材料中的关联与拓扑现象。

title: Odd-parity magnon spin polarization from chiral four-spin exchange in a honeycomb antiferromagnet
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, plus 6 pages of Supplemental Material
summary: Chiral four-spin exchange generates a momentum-dependent magnon spin in a compensated honeycomb antiferromagnet at zero magnetic field. For a Néel vector tilted by an angle $θ_0$ from the layer normal, the interaction contributes to intersublattice magnon pairing already at harmonic order, with an amplitude proportional to $\cosθ_0\sin^2θ_0$. Biaxial anisotropy mixes the two longitudinal-spin sectors, producing nonquantized mode spins that are odd in momentum, while a sublattice-exchange relation keeps the magnon energies reciprocal. A temperature gradient then induces a spin density along the Néel axis through a redistribution of magnon occupations. Reversing the four-spin coupling reverses this spin density and the mode spins without changing the magnon energies. MnPS$_3$ motivates the magnetic geometry; realizing the interaction requires a structural modification compatible with the symmetry assumptions of the model.

AI.tldr: 手性四自旋交换在补偿蜂窝反铁磁体中于零磁场产生动量依赖的磁振子自旋。
AI.motivation: 探索零磁场下无需外场即可产生动量依赖磁振子自旋的机制，并关联MnPS$_3$的磁性几何。
AI.method: 理论分析：考虑Néel矢量相对层法线倾斜$\theta_0$，研究手性四自旋交换对子晶格间磁振子配对（振幅$\propto \cos\theta_0\sin^2\theta_0$）及双轴各向异性混合纵向自旋的影响；用温度梯度驱动磁振子占据再分布。
AI.result: 双轴各向异性混合两个纵向自旋扇区，产生非量子化、关于动量奇对称的模式自旋；子晶格交换关系保持磁振子能量互易。温度梯度沿Néel轴诱导自旋密度。
AI.conclusion: 反转四自旋耦合会反转自旋密度与模式自旋而不改变磁振子能量；实现该相互作用需与模型对称性假设兼容的结构修饰。

title: Effect of Source-to-Substrate Distance on the Optical and Electrical Properties of Thermally Deposited CdTe, CdSe and Sb$_2$S$_3$ Thin Films
summary: In this work, cadmium telluride (CdTe), cadmium selenide (CdSe), and antimony sulfide (Sb\(_2\)S\(_3\)) thin films were deposited using the thermal evaporation technique by varying the source-to-substrate distance (SSD) from 15 to 24 cm (15, 18, 21, and 24 cm). The influence of the SSD on the structural, compositional, optical and electrical properties of the deposited films was systematically investigated. XRD analysis revealed the polycrystalline nature of the CdTe and CdSe thin films, whereas the Sb$_2$S$_3$ thin films exhibited an amorphous nature. EDX spectroscopy confirmed the presence of the constituent elements in the deposited films. Optical analysis revealed a marginal variation in the optical band gap with increasing SSD, while the film thickness, determined using the envelope method, decreased with increasing SSD. The optical band gap energies of CdTe and CdSe were found to be below 2 eV, whereas Sb$_2$S$_3$ exhibited a relatively higher band gap. The relatively low band gap energies and high absorption coefficients of the CdTe and CdSe films make them promising candidates for absorber layer applications in thin film solar cells (TFSCs). The films exhibited relatively low optical transmittance, which is desirable for efficient light absorption in absorber layers. Electrical characterization confirmed the semiconducting nature of all the deposited thin films. Overall, the results demonstrate that the optical and electrical properties of CdTe, CdSe and Sb$_2$S$_3$ thin films can be effectively modified by varying the SSD. The findings indicate that, in addition to the well established CdTe absorber, CdSe thin films show potential for application as absorber materials in TFSCs.

AI.tldr: 通过热蒸发法改变源-衬底距离(SSD,15–24 cm)沉积CdTe、CdSe和Sb₂S₃薄膜，系统研究SSD对结构、成分、光学和电学性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 探索沉积参数(源-衬底距离)如何调控薄膜性能，寻找除CdTe外可用于薄膜太阳能电池吸收层的新材料(如CdSe)。
AI.method: 热蒸发法沉积CdTe、CdSe、Sb₂S₃薄膜，SSD取15、18、21、24 cm；用XRD分析结构、EDX分析成分、包络法测厚度和光学性能、电学表征测导电性。

title: Hamiltonian curl-forces in systems coupled to multiple thermal reservoirs
summary: We investigate the statistical mechanics of a system coupled to multiple heat reservoirs at different temperatures, a setting which typically sustains nontrivial circulation. By applying a canonical transformation, we map the system onto that of a particle coupled to a single reservoir yet driven by a deterministic curl-force---a reversible, velocity-independent non-conservative force with non-vanishing curl---that can be described by a Hamiltonian with an anisotropic kinetic energy term. Despite the Hamiltonian structure, the system does not relax to the corresponding Boltzmann distribution, and is genuinely out of equilibrium. The mapping provides a mechanical interpretation of the currents in multi-temperature systems, as we demonstrate by means of two examples. In particular, the direction of circulation is qualitatively predictable from the deterministic force field. For the exactly solvable case of an $N$-dimensional underdamped Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we derive explicit expressions for the steady-state distribution and the entropy production rate, highlighting the role of the (generalized) curl of the force field in driving the system out of thermal equilibrium. Finally, we show how a non-conservative force can be used to exactly equilibrate any system coupled to multiple reservoirs, and obtain the corresponding equilibrium distribution.

AI.tldr: 通过正则变换，将多热库系统映射为受确定性旋力驱动的单热库粒子系统，揭示多温系统中环流的力学起源，并给出熵产生率与平衡条件。
AI.motivation: 多热库系统通常维持非平凡环流，其统计力学机制及电流的力学解释尚不清晰，作者希望找到统一描述并理解非平衡性的来源。
AI.method: 采用正则变换，将多热库耦合系统映射为单热库下受速度无关、非保守旋力（可由各向异性动能哈密顿量描述）驱动的系统；并以N维欠阻尼Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程为精确可解算例推导稳态分布与熵产生率。
AI.result: 该哈密顿系统不弛豫到玻尔兹曼分布，本质非平衡；环流方向可由确定性力场定性预测；精确得到OU过程的稳态分布与熵产生率，凸显（广义）旋度对非平衡的驱动作用；并证明可用非保守力使任意多热库系统达到精确平衡。
AI.conclusion: 多热库系统的环流具有明确的力学对应，旋度是关键非平衡驱动量；非保守力既可用于理解也可用于构造多热库系统的精确平衡态。

title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
comment: Main: 11 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary Information: 17 pages
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. We reduce crosstalk by 42$\times$ in this separated regime, enabling high-fidelity simultaneous single-qubit control, while control-Z operations can be implemented through shuttling and plunger-only control. These results promise high-connectivity quantum circuits, enabled by scaling to two-dimensional geometries and exploiting shuttling.

AI.tldr: 实现6×6半导体量子点阵列，通过相干自旋穿梭形成稀疏的10量子比特配置，降低串扰42倍，支持高保真并行单比特操控与穿梭型两比特门，迈向二维高连接量子电路。
AI.motivation: 容错量子计算需要在高保真操作的同时扩展比特数与连接性。半导体量子比特虽操作保真度高，但扩大规模且维持足够连接性困难，通常只能在单一空间方向扩展，以保留另一方向控制线的访问空间。
AI.method: 提出一种放宽制造要求的方法：用共享势垒栅与独立柱塞栅定义6×6量子点阵列；通过相干自旋穿梭将量子点（距离达5.2 μm）调谐为仅10个同时工作的稀疏比特配置，留出穿梭连接空间；利用分隔化布局抑制串扰。
