AI.conclusion: 该方案支持扩展至二维几何并利用穿梭，为高连接性量子电路提供路径。

title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, to appear in Phys. Rev. B
summary: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. We analytically map the parameter regions that support two-exciton BSs, proving that at most two distinct types of BSs can emerge, located either above or below the scattering continuum. Furthermore, we provide a quantitative interpretation of how these two types of BSs evolve as a function of the total wave number within the whole Brillouin zone. The obtained closed-form expressions for the eigenenergies and wave functions offer valuable benchmarks for exploring exciton dynamics and optical responses in related molecular aggregates.

AI.tldr: 本文对有限尺寸Merrifield链中的双激子问题给出了完整严格的解析解，证明最多存在两类束缚态并量化其随波数的演化。
AI.motivation: 双激子束缚态（BSs）对多激子现象研究和有机半导体设计至关重要，但其潜在晶格动力学机制尚不清楚。Merrifield激子模型能描述单点双激发态与双粒子散射连续谱间的量子混合，然而有限尺寸链中的双激子问题缺乏完整严格解。
AI.method: 构造一组精确的双激子Bloch态，并对由此产生的非均匀三对角矩阵采用平面波拟设（plane-wave ansatz）进行处理，从而求解有限尺寸Merrifield链中的双激子问题。
AI.result: 解析地刻画了支持双激子束缚态的参数区域，证明最多存在两类不同的束缚态，分别位于散射连续谱上方或下方；并定量解释了这两类束缚态在整个布里渊区内随总波数的演化。
AI.conclusion: 给出了本征能量和波函数的闭式表达式，可为相关分子聚集体中的激子动力学和光学响应研究提供基准参考。

title: Conditions for Altermagnetism in RuO2
summary: The magnetic ground state of rutile RuO2 remains disputed, raising a central question: under what structural and chemical conditions can this material support altermagnetism? We address this question by combining a critical assessment of experimental and theoretical studies with first-principles calculations of epitaxial strain, point defects, doping, and interfaces. Bulk-sensitive measurements reported in the literature are consistent with a nonmagnetic ground state, while magnetic signatures in thin films depend strongly on their structural environment and do not necessarily establish homogeneous altermagnetic order. Our calculations identify substrate-imposed epitaxial strain as the leading factor favoring altermagnetism among the conditions examined and predict several substrate-orientation combinations that stabilize an altermagnetic ground state. Carrier doping and chemical substitution modify this strain-induced magnetism in distinct ways. Uniform hole doping strengthens the magnetic tendency, whereas Ru vacancies provide little benefit and can weaken the magnetic state through local structural distortions. Cr or Mn substitution, by contrast, enhances Ru magnetic moments and further stabilizes the strained altermagnetic phase. These results distinguish the effects of carrier doping from those of local structural and chemical changes and identify concrete routes to realizing altermagnetism in RuO2 films.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合对实验与理论研究的批判性评估以及第一性原理计算，探讨了RuO2中交错磁性的形成条件。研究发现外延应变是最主要的促进因素，载流子掺杂与化学取代对其有不同影响，并识别出实现RuO2薄膜交错磁性的具体路径。
AI.motivation: 金红石RuO2的磁基态长期存在争议，核心问题是：在何种结构与化学条件下该材料能够支持交错磁性。这需要厘清实验与理论分歧，并明确可调控的实现条件。
AI.method: 结合对文献中实验与理论研究的批判性评估，并采用第一性原理计算，系统考察外延应变、点缺陷、掺杂以及界面的影响。
AI.result: 文献中体敏感测量结果与非磁基态一致，薄膜中的磁信号强烈依赖结构环境且未必证明均匀交错磁序。计算表明衬底施加的外延应变是促进交错磁性的主导因素，并预测了若干可稳定交错磁基态的衬底取向组合。均匀空穴掺杂增强磁性倾向，Ru空位益处不大甚至可通过局域结构畸变削弱磁态，而Cr或Mn取代则增强Ru磁矩并进一步稳定应变诱导的交错磁相。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了载流子掺杂与局域结构/化学变化的不同效应，并指出了在RuO2薄膜中实现交错磁性的具体途径。

title: Replica Fragmentation and Glassy Dynamics in Parity Learning
summary: We study how independently trained Transformer neural networks reconstruct a binary string from its local domain walls. Runs sharing the data and training protocol can realize different functions. We treat them as replicas and measure truth alignment $m$, prediction confidence $q_{\mathrm{self}}$, and cross-replica agreement $q_{\mathrm{cross}}$. Confident disagreement defines the finite-size replica fragmentation that we call glass-like. With small training sets, replicas predict all training examples correctly but remain confident in incorrect predictions for unseen inputs, a regime we call memorization. With larger sets, runs can generalize and then retreat. Retreat occurs when outputs start to deviate from truth while confidence remains high. The frontier between learned and unlearned outputs recedes toward shorter strings. Many later recover as the frontier advances again. The self--cross gap $q_{\mathrm{self}}-q_{\mathrm{cross}}$ clearly distinguishes the three learning regimes of memorization, retreat, and recovery. With overall and position-dependent truth alignment subtracted, their residual correlations also differ: memorizing replicas have weakly and uniformly correlated residuals, while retreat has the largest fraction of replica pairs whose residuals are anti-correlated. That is, on the inputs where one replica of such a pair does better than its average, the other tends to do worse. These finite-size observations distinguish persistent memorization from ongoing retreat--recovery dynamics. The thermodynamic and long-time limits, and extensions to other learning tasks, remain open.

AI.tldr: 独立训练的Transformer从局部畴壁重建二进制串时表现出三种学习阶段：记忆、退化与恢复，可用自-交叉置信差及残差相关性区分。
AI.motivation: 探究独立训练但共享数据与协议的Transformer复制体为何会实现不同功能，以及如何刻画其有限尺寸下的学习行为。
AI.method: 将同数据同协议训练的多次运行视为复制体，测量真值对齐度m、预测置信度q_self和跨复制体一致性q_cross，并用自-交叉差及去均值后的残差相关性分析。
AI.result: 小训练集下出现"记忆"（训练集全对但对未见输入自信地错）；较大训练集下可泛化后"退化"（输出偏离真值但置信度仍高），前沿向更短串收缩，之后许多又"恢复"；自-交叉差能区分三阶段，记忆体残差弱且均匀相关，退化时反相关复制体对占比最大。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺寸观察可区分持续记忆与持续的退化-恢复动态；热力学极限、长时极限及推广到其他任务仍待研究。

title: Bichargon Hall Effect
summary: The conventional Hall effect arises from the transverse deflection of mobile electronic charge carriers in conductors. Here, we predict a bosonic charge Hall effect in charge-ordered insulators mediated by bichargons, collective bosonic excitations of charge order carrying quantized electric charges $\pm 2e$. In contrast to conventional electronic carriers, a thermally excited bichargon gas does not support dc electrical conduction in response to an external electric field despite its constituents carrying finite electric charges. We show that a temperature gradient can instead drive a diffusive flow of thermal bichargons, while an out-of-plane magnetic field deflects the oppositely charged bichargons in opposite transverse directions via the Lorentz force, leading to a finite Hall charge current and opposite charge accumulations at the sample edges. Our results broaden the paradigm of charge Hall transport beyond conventional electronic conductors, establishing that a charge Hall response can emerge in an electrically \emph{insulating} system through charged bosonic quasiparticles.

AI.tldr: 本文预测在电荷有序绝缘体中存在由双荷子（bichargon，携带±2e的玻色型集体激发）中介的玻色型电荷霍尔效应，为绝缘体系中的电荷霍尔输运开辟新范式。
AI.motivation: 传统霍尔效应依赖导体中可移动电子载流子的横向偏转，本文将电荷霍尔输运的范畴拓展到电绝缘体系，探索由带电玻色型准粒子产生霍尔响应的可能性。
AI.method: 理论上预言电荷有序绝缘体中的双荷子——电荷序的玻色型集体激发，携带量子化电荷±2e；分析其在温度梯度驱动下的扩散流，以及外磁场通过洛伦兹力对正负荷电双荷子的反向偏转作用。
AI.result: 热激发的双荷子气体虽不响应外电场、不产生直流电导，但温度梯度可驱动其扩散流，垂直磁场使反号双荷子向相反方向偏转，从而产生有限霍尔电流及样品边缘的反号电荷积累。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明电荷霍尔响应可在电绝缘体系中通过带电荷的玻色型准粒子出现，把电荷霍尔输运范式拓展到传统电子导体之外。

title: Gradual Localization of Itinerant Cobalt 3d Electrons in the Pyrochlore Ferromagnetic Metal LuInCo4
summary: We investigated the microscopic magnetic state of the itinerant-electron ferromagnet LuInCo4 with a cobalt pyrochlore lattice by means of powder and single-crystal neutron diffraction measurements. The powder neutron diffraction profiles at zero field are well described by a simple q = 0 collinear ferromagnetic structure with an ordered Co moment of 0.9 uB. Single-crystal neutron diffraction experiments further suggest the absence of both antiferromagnetic order and long-period helical magnetic modulation. In addition, diffuse magnetic scattering was observed around q = 0, with its intensity distribution gradually broadened in reciprocal space upon cooling. Based on these observations, we propose a possible microscopic origin of the low-temperature metamagnetic transition in terms of a ferromagnetic instability enhanced by gradual localization of the itinerant Co-3d electrons. These results suggest that LuInCo4 provides a model system for investigating the interplay between electron localization and itinerant-electron ferromagnetism in cobalt-based metallic pyrochlore compounds.

AI.tldr: 通过中子衍射研究LuInCo4的微观磁态，发现其为零场下简单的q=0共线铁磁结构，Co有序磁矩约0.9 μB，不存在反铁磁序或长周期螺旋调制，但观察到随降温逐渐展宽的q=0弥散磁散射，据此提出低温变磁转变源于巡回Co-3d电子逐渐局域化增强的铁磁不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 研究钴基金属烧绿石化合物中电子局域化与巡回电子铁磁性之间的相互作用，理解LuInCo4低温变磁转变的微观机制。
AI.method: 采用粉末和单晶中子衍射测量，分析零场磁结构、检验反铁磁序和长周期螺旋调制，并观测q=0附近的弥散磁散射及其随温度的变化。
AI.result: 粉末谱符合q=0共线铁磁结构，Co有序磁矩0.9 μB；单晶实验表明无反铁磁序和长周期螺旋调制；q=0附近存在弥散磁散射，其倒空间强度分布随降温逐渐展宽。
AI.conclusion: 低温变磁转变可能源于巡回Co-3d电子逐渐局域化所增强的铁磁不稳定性；LuInCo4可作为研究钴基金属烧绿石中电子局域化与巡回电子铁磁性相互作用的模型体系。

title: Reliability of AI/ML Computational Searches for Magnetic Materials: Databases, Validation, and Synthesizability
summary: The rapid growth of AI/ML methods for materials discovery has increased the importance of the quality, physical completeness, and information content of computational databases. We examine these issues for magnetic materials, where incomplete sampling of competing magnetic states, chemical disorder, and finite-temperature properties can lead to apparently accurate but physically unreliable predictions. We propose a hierarchical discovery workflow combining independent ML models with explicit electronic-structure, magnetic, dynamical, thermodynamic, kinetic, and experimental validation. To incorporate kinetic accessibility into high-throughput screening, we introduce a dimensionless synthesis-window descriptor based on the relation between the chemical order-disorder and Tammann temperatures. A cluster-expansion analysis of Fe-Co-B illustrates the importance of this criterion: although ordered Fe3CoB2 is energetically favored at T=0, its small ordering energy produces an order-disorder temperature far below room temperature, making long-range Fe/Co ordering kinetically unachievable. These results demonstrate that reliable AI/ML discovery of magnetic materials requires databases and validation procedures that contain physical information relevant to the target functionality, rather than simply larger numbers of calculated structures.

AI.tldr: 针对AI/ML磁性材料发现中数据库物理完整性不足的问题，本文提出结合多模型与多层级验证的分层工作流，并引入基于化学有序-无序温度与Tammann温度的合成窗口描述符。Fe-Co-B案例表明有序相Fe3CoB2虽能量有利但动力学不可达，强调数据库应包含与目标功能相关的物理信息而非单纯更大规模。
AI.motivation: AI/ML材料发现依赖计算数据库，但现有数据库在磁性材料上存在物理不完整问题：竞争磁态采样不全、化学无序、有限温度性质缺失，导致预测看似准确却物理不可靠。需要解决数据质量与信息含量问题。
AI.method: 提出分层发现工作流，将多个独立ML模型与电子结构、磁性、动力学、热力学、动力学（kinetic）及实验验证相结合；并引入无量纲合成窗口描述符，基于化学有序-无序温度与Tammann温度的关系刻画动力学可达性；用团簇展开方法分析Fe-Co-B体系。
AI.result: Fe-Co-B的团簇展开分析显示：有序Fe3CoB2在T=0时能量有利，但其有序能很小，导致有序-无序温度远低于室温，长程Fe/Co有序在动力学上无法实现。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的AI/ML磁性材料发现要求数据库与验证流程包含与目标功能相关的物理信息，而不仅是更多计算结构数量。

title: Analytical results for the Shannon entropy of the critical transverse-field Ising chain
summary: Local-basis Shannon entropies of critical wave functions contain universal subleading information, but the Shannon point of the critical transverse-field Ising chain is singular in the conventional Rényi approach. We treat it directly at $n=1$ by representing the complete computational-basis Born distribution as the odd-degree boundary of independent long-range Bernoulli edges. The Shannon chain rule separates the entropy into explicit independent-edge and conditional cycle-space terms. For the periodic chain this isolates the analytic edge anomaly and organizes the remaining constant by linked vertex support. Conditional on the stated finite-part matching and forest assumptions, every nonvanishing linked coefficient is represented by an explicit finite-dimensional integral, giving an all-orders analytic hierarchy; the four-vertex term is evaluated in closed form, and the first few linked sectors already nearly saturate the established periodic constant, which is also reconstructed independently from the exact finite-size distribution. For an interval, the exterior reduces exactly to one ghost vertex and the explicit squared logarithms cancel, leaving the analytic edge contribution $γ_E=\log2/4-1/16$. The conditional cycle term has an exact all-support decomposition into physical-line and ghost-linked sectors; conditional on closure of the boundary forest subtraction, these sectors define an all-orders hierarchy of renormalized line and monomer--dimer boundary periods for the remaining logarithmic coefficient. The first complete augmented linked coefficient is evaluated in closed form, with an exact cancellation between its line and ghost boundary-layer anomalies; an independent reconstruction from exact finite-size probabilities recovers the established coefficient $γ_1=0.060020(3)$.

AI.tldr: 该文在 n=1 处直接处理临界横场 Ising 链的 Shannon 熵，通过把 Born 分布表示为独立长程 Bernoulli 边的奇次边界，分离出显式边项与条件循环空间项，构造全阶解析层级。
AI.motivation: 临界波函数的局域基 Shannon 熵含普适次领头信息，但临界横场 Ising 链的 Shannon 点在传统 Rényi 方法中是奇异的，无法用常规 n→1 极限处理。
AI.method: 将计算基 Born 分布表示为一组独立长程 Bernoulli 边的奇次边界，利用 Shannon 链式法则分解为独立边项与条件循环空间项；周期链下孤立解析边反常，按连通顶点支撑组织常数；区间情形外部约化为单 ghost 顶点，显式平方对数相消。
AI.result: 在给定有限部分匹配与森林假设下，每个非零连通系数由显式有限维积分给出，得到全阶解析层级；四点项闭式求出，前几个连通扇区几乎饱和已知周期常数，并可由精确有限尺寸分布独立重建。区间得到解析边贡献 γ_E=log2/4−1/16；条件循环项有精确全支撑分解，首个完整增广连通系数闭式求出，线项与 ghost 边界层反常精确相消，独立重建给出 γ_1=0.060020(3)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 Shannon 点奇异问题提供了 n=1 直接重表述与全阶层级结构，将周期与区间常数化归为边反常、cycle-space 项及重整化线/单体–二聚体边界周期，并数值验证已知常数。

title: Theory of Magic Angles in Twisted Bilayer Graphene: from Non-Abelian Gauge Fields to Flat Bands
summary: At a discrete set of ``magic'' twist angles, twisted bilayer graphene develops two bands at charge neutrality that are almost perfectly flat. We present a unified theory of this phenomenon within the chiral continuum model. The central object is the square of the chiral Hamiltonian, a $2\times2$ Schrödinger operator for an electron moving in a non-Abelian $SU(2)$ pseudo-magnetic field generated by the interlayer tunneling. From it we derive an energy sum rule in which the interlayer coupling splits into a bounded overlap channel and an unbounded current channel; their different scaling with the coupling $α$ explains why the first magic angle is qualitatively different from the rest. The asymptotic rule $α_{m+1}-α_m\to3/2$ follows from a rescaling of the moiré potential together with its three-cell magnetic periodicity, with the two parity families of zero modes each repeating with period $3$ and interleaved with each other. Near the AA point the zero-mode problem becomes a lowest-Landau-level problem in an effective field $B_{\rm eff}=3α$, so that the high-order zero modes are coherent Landau states of width $1/\sqrt{3α}$ whose guiding centres converge to $\pm(π/3) q_μ$, with kinetic and confinement energies in equipartition. Deforming the coupling into an Abelian one removes the magic-angle sequence, which shows that the non-Abelian structure is essential. Between consecutive magic angles, band inversions at $Γ$ and $M$ produce phases with Chern numbers $C=\pm2$, and the quantum metric reaches a sharp maximum at $θ\approx0.43^\circ$, identifying a promising regime for correlated and topological phases beyond the first magic angle.

AI.tldr: 在手性连续模型中提出统一理论，揭示魔角序列起源：手性哈密顿量平方对应非阿贝尔SU(2)赝磁场中的薛定谔算子，导出能级求和规则与魔角渐近规律，并预测高阶魔角附近的拓扑相与量子几何特征。
AI.motivation: 解释扭角双层石墨烯在电荷中性点出现近平坦带的"魔角"现象，并理解为何第一魔角与其余魔角定性不同，尤其是魔角序列的数学起源及非阿贝尔结构的必要性。
AI.method: 在手性连续模型框架下，研究手性哈密顿量的平方——即电子在层间隧穿产生的非阿贝尔SU(2)赝磁场中运动的2×2薛定谔算子；通过推导能量求和规则（层间耦合分解为有界重叠通道与无界电流通道）、对莫尔势及其三胞磁周期性的重标度分析，以及AA点附近的朗道能级对应，来刻画零模与魔角序列。
AI.result: 层间耦合经求和规则分成有界重叠通道与无界电流通道，其随α的不同标度解释了第一魔角与其余魔角的定性差异；导出渐近规律α_{m+1}-α_m→3/2，两个宇称零模族各以周期3重复并交错；AA点附近零模问题化为有效场B_eff=3α的最低朗道能级问题，高阶零模为宽度1/√(3α)的相干朗道态，导向中心收敛到±(π/3)q_μ，动能与束缚能均分。将耦合变形为阿贝尔型则魔角序列消失，说明非阿贝尔结构的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 非阿贝尔SU(2)赝磁场结构是魔角序列存在的关键。相邻魔角间Γ与M点的带反转产生Chern数C=±2的相，量子度量在θ≈0.43°处达到尖锐极大，指认该区域为探索超越第一魔角的关联与拓扑相的有前景区间。

title: Symmetry protected quantum many body scars through half-gauging
summary: We study the interplay between symmetry defects insertion and the phenomena of quantum many body scarring. We exploit a class of models obtained from an embedding mechanism that defines a stochastic matrix form hamiltonian, hosting zero energy many body scarred states. Such models display an interesting playground to explore the consequences of dualities, half-gauging operations and so on. We first show that inside this class of models, what are the conditions to still have scared states after defect insertion. The main result of our work is a detailed analysis of half-gauging in such chains, which introduces a non-trivial interface in our system, leading to scarred states protected by the underlying symmetries. The conclusions for half-gauged scarred systems are general and may lead to fruitful directions for higher dimension scarred physics and their robustness.

AI.tldr: 研究对称缺陷插入与量子多体疤痕的相互作用，重点分析半规范化操作在疤痕态中引入非平凡界面并产生受对称性保护的疤痕态。
AI.motivation: 探索对称缺陷插入、对偶性和半规范化等操作对量子多体疤痕现象的影响，并寻求向高维疤痕物理及其鲁棒性推广的途径。
AI.method: 利用一种嵌入机制构造的随机矩阵形式哈密顿量模型（可承载零能多体疤痕态），系统分析缺陷插入后疤痕态存在的条件，并详细研究半规范化在该类链中引入非平凡界面的效应。
AI.result: 给出了该类模型在缺陷插入后仍保持疤痕态的条件；发现半规范化会引入非平凡界面，并导致由底层对称性保护的新疤痕态。
AI.conclusion: 关于半规范化疤痕系统的结论具有一般性，可能为高维疤痕物理及其鲁棒性研究提供有益方向。

title: Determination of Burgers-vector directions of threading edge dislocations in GaN by phase-contrast microscopy
summary: Phase-contrast microscopy enables rapid, nondestructive observation of threading dislocations in GaN, but the relationship between dislocation contrast and the Burgers vector has not been established. Here, we demonstrate that the in-plane Burgers-vector direction of threading edge dislocations in GaN can be determined from the arrangement of bright and dark contrast in phase-contrast microscopy images. The relationship was first established for threading edge dislocations in ammonothermal GaN whose Burgers vectors were independently determined by X-ray topography and was subsequently applied to hydride vapor phase epitaxy-grown GaN. The Burgers vector predicted from the phase contrast was verified by weak-beam dark-field TEM and large-angle convergent-beam electron diffraction. For the threading edge dislocations examined, the direction obtained by rotating the direction from the minimum of the dark contrast to the maximum of the bright contrast by 90° counterclockwise coincided with the Burgers-vector direction. Analysis based on the photoelastic effect further suggests that the phase contrast primarily reflects the sum of the two in-plane normal strain components, εxx + εyy, around the dislocation. These results demonstrate that phase-contrast microscopy can be used as a nondestructive optical method for determining the in-plane Burgers-vector direction of threading edge dislocations in GaN.

AI.tldr: 本文证明相衬显微镜可通过明暗衬度排布判定GaN中穿透刃位错的面内Burgers矢量方向，并用X射线形貌、TEM等验证。
AI.motivation: 相衬显微镜能快速、无损观察GaN穿透位错，但位错衬度与Burgers矢量之间的关系尚未建立，限制了其用于确定Burgers矢量。
AI.method: 先在Burgers矢量已知（X射线形貌确定）的氨热法GaN刃位错中建立相衬明暗排布与Burgers矢量的关系，再应用于HVPE生长的GaN；用弱束暗场TEM和大角度会聚束电子衍射验证预测；并用光弹效应分析衬度来源。
AI.result: 从暗衬度最小方向到亮衬度最大方向逆时针旋转90°即与Burgers矢量方向一致；光弹效应分析表明相衬主要反映位错周围两个面内正应变分量之和εxx+εyy。
AI.conclusion: 相衬显微镜可作为一种无损光学方法确定GaN穿透刃位错的面内Burgers矢量方向。

title: Fast free-energy estimation for complex systems with nonreversible simulated tempering
summary: We discuss free-energy estimation for complex systems using simulated tempering with Wang--Landau-type feedback. We show that introducing nonreversible dynamics in temperature space and multiple temperature updates per step significantly accelerates the convergence of the free-energy estimate. We then apply the algorithm to the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson spin-glass model. Our results show that the algorithm can precisely estimate the free energy up to a large system size $L \simeq 64$, and that subsequent equilibrium simulated tempering simulations with the estimated free energy can rapidly sample from the Boltzmann distributions over a wide temperature range that covers the spin-glass transition temperature. The convergence time of our algorithm grows much more slowly with system size than that of another known algorithm for on-the-fly free-energy estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Wang-Landau型反馈的模拟退火（simulated tempering）估计复杂系统的自由能，通过引入非可逆温度动力学和每步多次温度更新显著加速收敛，并在3D Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃上验证，可精确估计至L≃64的自由能。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统（如自旋玻璃）的自由能估计困难，现有在线自由能估计方法收敛随系统尺寸增长过快，需要更高效的算法。
AI.method: 在模拟退火中引入Wang-Landau型反馈估计自由能；采用非可逆的温度空间动力学，并在每一步进行多次温度更新。
AI.result: 在3D Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃上，算法可精确估计至L≃64的自由能；用估计的自由能进行后续平衡模拟退火，可在覆盖自旋玻璃转变温度的宽温度范围内快速采样；收敛时间随系统尺寸的增长远慢于另一种在线自由能估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法能高效、精确地估计大尺寸复杂系统自由能并快速采样，收敛性显著优于现有方法。

title: Ferroaxial Electronic Response to Local Lattice Rotation
summary: We theoretically investigate electronic responses to lattice deformation in a ferroaxial system using a tight-binding model on a two-dimensional square lattice and linear response theory. While conventional elastic responses are commonly discussed in terms of symmetric strain, the displacement gradient also contains an antisymmetric component describing a local lattice rotation. Focusing on this rotational degree of freedom, we treat the symmetric strain and antisymmetric local rotation as independent perturbations and incorporate their effects microscopically through deformation-induced modulations of the electronic hopping amplitudes. We find that the local rotation induces characteristic diagonal electric quadrupoles that are distinct from those generated by the symmetric shear strain. The rotation-induced response is dominated by the intraband contribution and increases approximately linearly with the ferroaxial crystal field, vanishing in the absence of ferroaxial order. In contrast, the symmetric-shear-induced response remains finite without ferroaxial order and contains both intraband and interband contributions. These results demonstrate that the antisymmetric local rotation provides a distinct electronic response channel characteristic of the ferroaxial state.

AI.tldr: 本文用紧束缚模型与线性响应理论研究铁轴(ferroaxial)体系中电子对晶格形变的响应，指出局域旋转(反对称分量)诱导对角电四极子，且响应随铁轴晶体场近似线性增强并依赖铁轴序。
AI.motivation: 传统弹性响应多以对称应变为出发点，但位移梯度还含描述局域晶格旋转的反对称分量。作者希望将对称应变与反对称局域旋转视为独立微扰，揭示铁轴体系中该旋转自由度的独特电子响应。
AI.method: 在二维正方格子上构建紧束缚模型，利用线性响应理论；将位移梯度分离为对称应变与反对称局域旋转，通过形变导致的电子跃迁振幅调制微观地引入两者效应，并分别计算其电四极子响应。
AI.result: 局域旋转诱导出与对称剪切应变不同的特征对角电四极子；旋转诱导响应以带内贡献为主，随铁轴晶体场近似线性增长，在无铁轴序时消失；对称剪切响应在无铁轴序时仍有限且含带内与带间贡献。
AI.conclusion: 反对称局域旋转提供了铁轴态特有的电子响应通道，可作为区分铁轴序的探针。

title: Exchange self-energy and vertex corrections to static screening in the two-dimensional electron gas
summary: We compute analytically the leading beyond-ring corrections to the static irreducible polarizability of the two-dimensional (2D) electron gas, namely the two exchange self-energy diagrams and the exchange vertex diagram, each of first order in the Coulomb coupling, and insert the resulting polarizability into the RPA geometric series to obtain the static dielectric function and screened interaction. The self-energy and vertex contributions individually diverge; we obtain both divergent pieces in closed form. Their sum is finite and reproduces exactly the Hartree-Fock compressibility, which renormalizes the Thomas-Fermi wave vector. We show that exchange converts the one-sided 2D Kohn kink at 2k_F into a sharp two-sided peak, a qualitative improvement over Thomas-Fermi and RPA screening. In real space this makes the Friedel oscillations around a charged impurity 2-3 times larger than in RPA, with an amplitude that increases with distance over the range studied; implications for Kohn-Luttinger pairing are discussed. Relation to earlier works on the same diagrams is discussed.

AI.tldr: 该论文解析计算了二维电子气静态不可约极化率的领头"超越环图"修正（两个交换自能图和一个交换顶点图），并将其代入RPA几何级数得到静态介电函数和屏蔽相互作用。
AI.motivation: RPA屏蔽忽略了交换效应，需要引入超越环图的交换修正以更准确地描述二维电子气的介电响应和屏蔽行为。
AI.method: 解析计算两个交换自能图和一个交换顶点图（对库仑耦合一阶），分别得到自能和顶点的发散部分闭式表达，求和后代入RPA几何级数。
AI.result: 自能与顶点贡献各自发散但求和有限，精确重现Hartree-Fock可压缩性，重整Thomas-Fermi波矢；交换将单侧2D Kohn kink变为尖锐双侧峰；实空间Friedel振荡幅度比RPA大2-3倍且随距离增加。
AI.conclusion: 交换修正显著改善了二维电子气屏蔽的描述，对Kohn-Luttinger配对有重要启示，并与早期相关图工作进行了对比讨论。

title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction
summary: A central challenge for scientific agents is to turn analytical experience into reusable expertise grounded in physical evidence. Here we introduce Gan Jiang, a self-learning agent for powder X-ray diffraction built on a diffraction-analysis ecosystem we developed: XMatcher, XQueryer, XDecomposer and WPEM. Together, these engines span phase identification, multiphase decomposition and physics-constrained whole-pattern modelling. Gan Jiang converts analytical experience into executable skills by diagnosing failures, revising skill instructions and code, and validating revisions before reuse, without retraining the language model or changing the underlying physical models. Skills selected using development data and frozen before held-out evaluation achieve higher refinement scores than the original expert-designed skills across FullProf, GSAS-II and PyWPEM. The agent resolves strongly overlapping reflections, quantifies a five-phase ancient Egyptian cosmetic, tracks lattice evolution in an operating battery and compares atomic configurations in a disordered oxide catalyst. On DeltaXRDbench, it leads the evaluated methods in single- and multiphase identification across simulated and experimental data. Without supplied composition, single-phase top-1 accuracies reach 96.30\%, 81.78\% and 40.83\% on MP500, RRUFF and opXRD, respectively, compared with 58.00\%, 58.47\% and 26.45\% for the strongest comparator. These results demonstrate how an integrated scientific tool ecosystem can support agents that extract structural knowledge from measurements while accumulating validated analytical expertise that transfers to new samples.

AI.tldr: 介绍Gan Jiang——一个自学习粉末X射线衍射智能体，通过将分析经验转化为可执行技能，在相鉴定和全谱建模中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体的核心挑战在于将分析经验转化为基于物理证据的可复用专业知识，而非依赖模型重训练。
AI.method: 构建衍射分析生态（XMatcher、XQueryer、XDecomposer、WPEM），Gan Jiang通过诊断失败、修订技能指令与代码并验证后再复用，将经验转为可执行技能，且不重训LLM或改动物理模型。
AI.result: 技能在FullProf、GSAS-II、PyWPEM上改进分数高于专家设计技能；可解析重叠反射、量化五相古埃及化妆品、追踪电池晶格演化、比较无序氧化物催化剂构型；在DeltaXRDbench上领先，单相top-1达96.30%/81.78%/40.83%（MP500/RRUFF/opXRD），远超最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 集成的科学工具体系可支撑智能体从测量中提取结构知识，并积累可迁移到新样品的经验证分析专业能力。

title: Algebraic Tensor Network Renormalization and Holographic duality
summary: Emergent generalized symmetries and the holographic principle play very important roles in understanding quantum phase transitions. In recent years, tensor-network renormalization with generalized symmetry and the corresponding fixed-point tensor formulation have been proposed as a discrete spacetime framework for reformulating conformal field theory. Nevertheless, a complete holographic formulation within this framework is still lacking, and the current formulation does not directly accommodate sector partition functions that are modular covariant in general. In this work, we formulate $\mathcal{R}$-TNR, which builds the categorical constraints of a fusion category $\mathcal{R}$ into local tensor spaces and preserves these constraints under Loop-TNR. For suitable choices of $\mathcal{R}$, the initial tensors constructed here flow under $\mathcal{R}$-Loop-TNR to stable gapless fixed points. In the Ising, tricritical Ising, and three-state Potts conformal field theory examples, a broad range of initial parameters leads to the same gapless fixed point in each example. The method resolves conformal towers by anyon sector and yields scaling dimensions, conformal spins, and magnitudes of sector-resolved structure constants with extremely high accuracy compared to previous methods. These results realize a topological bootstrap based on stable symmetry-topological-order in which finite categorical and geometric input, together with an initial tensor that need not be fine-tuned, suffices to recover the infrared conformal field theory and its sector-resolved conformal data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 R-TNR，将融合范畴 R 的范畴约束嵌入局部张量空间，并在 Loop-TNR 下保持，实现对共形场论的分区函数与拓扑引导的精确重构。
AI.motivation: 广义对称性与全息原理对理解量子相变很重要，张量网络重整化已用于共形场论的离散时空重构，但缺乏完整全息表述，且难以直接处理模协变的扇区分区函数。
AI.method: 构造 R-TNR：把融合范畴 R 的范畴约束编码进局部张量空间，并用 R-Loop-TNR 保持这些约束，使初始张量流向无隙稳定不动点。
AI.result: 在 Ising、三临界 Ising 与三态 Potts 共形场论中，广泛初始参数均流向同一无隙不动点；按任意子扇区解析共形塔，高精度给出标度维数、共形自旋与扇区分辨结构常数模长。
AI.conclusion: 结果实现了基于稳定对称-拓扑序的拓扑引导：有限范畴与几何输入加无需微调的初始张量即可恢复红外共形场论及其扇区分辨共形数据。

title: Negative charging energy in LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ quantum dots induced by SrTiO$_3$ polarization
summary: We propose a microscopic mechanism for the negative charging energy in LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ quantum dots, arising from the electrostatic image charge associated with the paraelectric response of SrTiO$_3$. Using a self-consistent configuration-interaction approach that accounts for both Coulomb repulsion and image-charge interactions, we find a robust regime of electron pairing whose strength is tunable through the confinement potential and the effective image-charge distance, set by the thickness of the interfacial two-dimensional electron gas. Our results establish dielectric image-charge effects as a route to controllable electron pairing in oxide quantum dots and other materials with a strong dielectric response.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LaAlO3/SrTiO3量子点中负充电能的微观机制：SrTiO3顺电响应产生的静电镜像电荷。用自洽组态相互作用方法发现可调电子配对，强度由限域势和镜像电荷距离控制。
AI.motivation: 解释LaAlO3/SrTiO3量子点中负充电能的微观起源，并探索介电镜像电荷效应对电子配对的可控性。
AI.method: 采用自洽组态相互作用方法，同时考虑库仑排斥与镜像电荷相互作用，研究限域势与有效镜像电荷距离对配对的影响。
AI.result: 发现存在稳健的电子配对区间，其强度可通过限域势及由界面二维电子气厚度决定的镜像电荷距离进行调节。
AI.conclusion: 介电镜像电荷效应可作为在氧化物量子点及其他强介电响应材料中实现可控电子配对的途径。

title: Incoherent Spectral Weight Emerging from a Van Hove Singularity in a Kagome Metal
summary: Waterfall-like spectral features observed by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) are commonly associated with strong electronic correlations or electron-boson coupling. Here, we investigate this connection in the kagome metal LuFe6Ge6, a structurally simple member of the FeGe-derived family, using polarization-dependent ARPES, density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory. We observe a pronounced vertical spectral feature at the L point extending over several hundred meV in binding energy. Its orbital character is identified as predominantly Fe dyz, and its energy onset coincides with a van Hove singularity located approximately 0.3 eV below EF . Despite the waterfall-like spectral response, dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) reveals only weak electronic correlations, while the calculated electronic structure closely reproduces the experimental bulk bands. We propose that the anomalous spectral weight may arise from inelastic scattering of the outgoing photoelectrons, potentially associated with the large density of states near the van Hove singularity. Our results suggest that waterfall-like features can emerge without strong electronic correlations and highlight the possible role of the underlying band structure and photoelectron energy-loss processes in their interpretation.

AI.tldr: 在kagome金属LuFe6Ge6中观察到瀑布状谱特征，但DMFT显示电子关联很弱，该异常可能源于光电子非弹性散射而非强关联。
AI.motivation: 瀑布状谱特征通常被认为与强电子关联或电子-玻色子耦合相关，但这一关联是否普适需要检验。作者选取结构简单的FeGe衍生kagome金属LuFe6Ge6来探究此联系。
AI.method: 结合偏振依赖ARPES、DFT和DMFT，对LuFe6Ge6的电子结构进行研究。
AI.result: 在L点观察到延伸数百meV的垂直谱特征，轨道以Fe dyz为主，其能量起始与EF以下约0.3 eV处的van Hove奇点一致。DMFT表明电子关联很弱，计算的体能带与实验符合良好。
AI.conclusion: 瀑布状特征可在无强电子关联情况下出现，可能由出射光电子的非弹性散射（与van Hove奇点附近的高态密度有关）导致，提示解释该类特征时须考虑能带结构与光电子能量损失过程。

title: Calculation of structural symmetry and applicability of small AkBlCm nanoclusters (A=Rb, Cs; B=Pb, Sn, Bi; C=Cl, Br, I) as building blocks for synthesis of larger-size nanoclusters
summary: In this report we analyze charasteristics of structural symmetry of small AkBlCm nanoclusters (A - Rb, Cs; B - Pb, Sn, Bi; C - Cl, Br, I), binding energies, stability, and, ultimately, applicability as building blocks for construction of larger-size nanoclusters. Preliminary spatial modeling of ternary compound nanoclusters has been carried out on the basics of geometrical approach, namely interatomic distances taken as a sums of corresponding ionic radii. The geometry optimization and binding energies of the modeled structures have been determined through quantum-chemical calculations. Geometry optimization has been performed with Gaussian09 software package using Density Functional Theory (DFT) within the generalized gradient approximation of the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) and hybrid approximation of the Becke-3-Lee-Yang-Parr (B3LYP) exchange-correlation functionals. The Stuttgart/Dresden (SDD) and Los Alamos National Laboratory 2 Double Zeta (LANL2DZ) scalar-relativistic effective basic potentials were employed throughout the calculations. As a result of these calculations, a clear relationship between the atomic radii, their ratios within the nanoclusters and their stability has been obtained and analyzed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过几何建模与DFT量子化学计算，研究三元AkBlCm纳米团簇的结构对称性、结合能、稳定性及其作为大尺寸团簇构建单元的潜力，并揭示了原子半径比与稳定性之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 探索小型三元纳米团簇（A-Rb/Cs, B-Pb/Sn/Bi, C-Cl/Br/I）的结构对称性与稳定性，判断其能否作为构建更大纳米团簇的基本单元。
AI.method: 基于几何方法（以离子半径之和作为原子间距）进行初步空间建模；采用Gaussian09进行DFT几何优化与结合能计算，泛函为PBE（广义梯度近似）和B3LYP（杂化），并使用SDD和LANL2DZ标量相对论有效核势。
AI.result: 获得了原子半径、团簇内半径比值与其稳定性之间的明确关系，并进行了分析。
AI.conclusion: 原子半径及其比值与三元纳米团簇稳定性存在明确关联，可据此指导其作为大尺寸团簇构建单元的应用。

title: Dynamical vertex approximation for retarded interactions: Application to the Hubbard-Holstein model
summary: We extend the dynamical vertex approximation (D$Γ$A), in its most commonly used ladder-version, to systems with retarded electronic interactions. Such an extended scheme, which we name "dynamical-$U$ D$Γ$A", allows us to study strongly interacting electrons coupled to bosons including non-local spatial correlations on all length scales on top of the purely local ones captured by dynamical mean-field theory. We demonstrate the applicability of the method in the specific case of the coupling to a single dispersionless phononic mode, by studying the Hubbard-Holstein model on the square and cubic lattices, focusing on regimes of sizable Hubbard interactions where strong electronic correlations compete with phonon-mediated interactions. As illustrative examples, we consider the antiferromagnetic phase in the three-dimensional model and the d-wave superconductor in two dimensions, analyzing the effect of the electron-phonon coupling, including its frequency dependence, on both instabilities.

AI.tldr: 该文将动力学顶点近似(DΓA)的梯形版本推广到含延迟电子相互作用体系，提出"dynamical-U DΓA"，可同时处理强关联与非局域空间关联，并在Hubbard-Holstein模型上验证。
AI.motivation: DMFT仅捕捉局域关联，而真实材料中电子-玻色子(声子)耦合带来延迟(频率依赖)相互作用与非局域关联，需在强关联框架中加以统一处理。已有DΓA处理瞬时相互作用，尚无针对延迟相互作用的推广。
AI.method: 将常用梯形DΓA推广至延迟电子相互作用，称之为dynamical-U DΓA：在DMFT局域关联基础上，纳入所有长度尺度的非局域空间关联，并保留相互作用的频率依赖。以单一无色散声子模式的Hubbard-Holstein模型为具体检验对象，在方形与立方格子上进行数值计算，重点考察Hubbard相互作用与声子介导相互作用相互竞争的区域。
AI.result: 在三维模型中分析了反铁磁相，在二维模型中分析了d波超导，考察了电子-声子耦合(含其频率依赖)对这两类不稳定性/本征失稳的影响。
AI.conclusion: dynamical-U DΓA为研究延迟相互作用与强电子关联共存体系提供了可行工具，可统一描述局域与非局域关联，并成功应用于Hubbard-Holstein模型中反铁磁与d波超导的竞争分析。

title: First principles modeling of group-III acceptors and their potential lifetime-limiting effects in n-type 4H-SiC
summary: Accurate modeling of p-type dopants in 4H-SiC is essential for understanding the mechanisms governing doping efficiency and carrier transport. In this work, we revisit the electronic structure of boron- and aluminum-related acceptors using hybrid density functional methods. Besides defect formation energies and thermodynamic transition levels, we present a quantitative look into the carrier capture kinetics within the multi-phonon emission framework. Our results reveal striking differences between the two most relevant p-type dopants. While $\textrm{B}_{\textrm{Si}}$ and $\textrm{B}_{\textrm{C}}$ exhibit nearly identical formation energies, consistent with the occurrence of both defects, the formation energy of $\textrm{Al}_{\textrm{C}}$ under intrinsic conditions is approximately 6.5 eV higher than that of $\textrm{Al}_{\textrm{Si}}$, confirming previous findings that the former is unlikely to occur. We further find that $\textrm{B}_{\textrm{Si}}$ possesses large electron and hole capture cross sections, identifying it as a plausible source of minority-carrier lifetime degradation of n-type material contaminated with boron. In addition, we predict a previously unexplored donor transition for $\textrm{B}_{\textrm{C}}$. If experimentally confirmed, this defect would represent additional problems to both p-type doped and boron contaminated 4H-SiC, not only because of its ineffectiveness as an electric dopant, but also due to trapping of up to two free holes, reducing the free-hole concentration and increasing scattering effects.

AI.tldr: 用混合密度泛函方法重新研究了4H-SiC中B和Al相关受主的电子结构，揭示两种p型掺杂剂的显著差异，并预测B_C的新施主跃迁。
AI.motivation: 准确建模4H-SiC中的p型掺杂剂对理解掺杂效率和载流子输运机制至关重要，因此需要重新审视B和Al相关受主的电子结构。
AI.method: 采用混合密度泛函方法计算缺陷形成能、热力学跃迁能级，并在多声子发射框架下定量分析载流子俘获动力学。
AI.result: B_Si和B_C形成能几乎相同；Al_C本征条件下形成能比Al_Si高约6.5 eV，证实其不易形成；B_Si具有较大的电子和空穴俘获截面，可能是n型材料少子寿命退化的来源；预测了B_C此前未探索的施主跃迁。
AI.conclusion: B_C的新施主跃迁若被实验证实，将给p型掺杂和硼污染的4H-SiC带来额外问题：不仅作为电掺杂剂无效，还会俘获最多两个自由空穴，降低自由空穴浓度并增强散射效应。

title: Interfacial Charge Transfer and Morphology Govern Magnetism in Ultrathin VOx/MoSe2 Heterostructures
summary: Engineering magnetism in two-dimensional semiconductors through interfacial interactions offers an attractive alternative to substitutional doping and provides opportunities for integrating magnetic and optoelectronic functionality within the same heterostructure. Here, we investigate ultrathin VOx films deposited on monolayer MoSe2 and demonstrate a pronounced enhancement of the magnetic response upon formation of the VOx/MoSe2 interface. Combined structural, spectroscopic, magnetic, and first-principles analyses support a consistent picture in which finite VOx clusters possess intrinsic magnetic moments that are further enhanced by electron transfer from MoSe2 to the oxide. The predicted charge transfer is also consistent with the increased trion contribution observed in the photoluminescence response of the heterostructure. Beyond this interfacial enhancement, the magnetic behavior is strongly governed by the morphology of the ultrathin oxide. A crossover from discontinuous clusters to more continuous films produces qualitatively different temperature dependences: the continuous-film regime exhibits conventional thermal demagnetization and coercive softening, whereas the clustered regime displays an unusual increase in magnetization and nonmonotonic coercivity with increasing temperature. These contrasting responses are captured by a phenomenological model in which morphology determines the collective magnetic dynamics through a distribution of effective reversal barriers and their thermally activated accessibility. Together, the results establish a unified picture in which interfacial charge transfer enhances the local magnetic moments of VOx, while nanoscale morphology governs their collective magnetic dynamics, providing complementary routes for controlling magnetism in oxide/transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 通过在单层MoSe2上沉积超薄VOx形成界面，实现磁性的显著增强，并揭示界面电荷转移与纳米形貌分别调控局域磁矩与集体磁动力学的双重机制。
AI.motivation: 传统替位掺杂调控二维半导体磁性存在局限，界面相互作用提供了一种兼具磁性与光电功能集成的替代方案，但其微观机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 结合结构表征、光谱学、磁性测量与第一性原理计算，系统研究VOx/MoSe2异质结；并通过唯象模型（有效翻转势垒分布及其热激活可达性）解释形貌依赖的磁行为。
AI.result: VOx/MoSe2界面形成后磁响应显著增强，MoSe2向氧化物电子转移增强有限VOx团簇的磁矩，且与光致发光中三激子贡献增加一致；形貌决定温度依赖：连续薄膜表现常规热退磁与矫顽力软化，团簇态则出现磁化随温度升高而增强及非单调矫顽力。
AI.conclusion: 界面电荷转移增强VOx局域磁矩，纳米形貌主导其集体磁动力学，为氧化物/过渡金属硫族化物异质结中的磁性调控提供了互补途径。

title: Ghost rotationally invariant slave-boson approach to response functions
summary: We propose a finite-temperature Gaussian-fluctuation formalism for response functions within ghost rotationally invariant slave-boson (gRISB) theory and apply it to the two-dimensional Hubbard model. The gRISB magnetic phase boundary and static spin and charge susceptibilities capture the trends of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), significantly improving upon standard RISB and the random phase approximation (RPA). At the RISB level, our formalism recovers the Kotliar-Ruckenstein response. The dynamical susceptibilities resolve paramagnons, low-energy sound modes, and high-energy Hubbard excitations. Because they are evaluated directly on the real-frequency axis, the results avoid Matsubara truncation, stochastic sampling, and numerical analytic continuation. We also introduce a conserving quasiparticle approximation that expresses the response in terms of dressed Green's functions and vertex corrections.

AI.tldr: 本文在ghost旋转不变从仆玻色子(gRISB)理论中提出有限温度高斯涨落响应函数方法，并应用于二维Hubbard模型，准确刻画磁性相边界及自旋/电荷响应。
AI.motivation: 标准RISB和RPA对二维Hubbard模型的响应函数描述不足，而DMFT计算代价高。需要一种能捕捉DMFT趋势、且避免Matsubara截断和数值解析延拓的响应函数方法。
AI.method: 在gRISB框架下建立有限温度高斯涨落形式，直接在实频轴上计算响应函数；在RISB极限下可还原Kotliar-Ruckenstein响应，并引入守恒准粒子近似，用重整化格林函数和顶点修正表达响应。
AI.result: gRISB的磁相边界和静态自旋/电荷磁化率捕捉到DMFT趋势，显著优于标准RISB和RPA；动态磁化率分辨出顺磁子、低能声模和高能Hubbard激发，且无需Matsubara截断、随机采样或数值解析延拓。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为强关联体系提供了一种高效、实频轴上的响应函数计算方法，是RISB向响应性质扩展的重要进展。

title: Mechanistic transition between inter- and trans-granular creep cracking via a unified crystal plasticity-fracture framework
summary: High-temperature creep in metals remains challenging due to the complex interplay of deformation and failure mechanisms across multiple length scales. The trade-off between inter- and trans-granular cracking governs the transition of creep rupture behaviour in metallic materials. However, the micromechanical basis of the transition and its linkage to the macroscopic brittle to ductile transition in creep rupture behaviour remain unresolved. Here, the stress-dependent competition between grain-boundary cavitation and slip-induced intragranular cracking is revealed via a unified crystal plasticity fracture framework. The framework incorporates crystal plasticity, grain-boundary cavitation, and crystallographic crack propagation within an explicit polycrystalline microstructure. The microscale computation reveals the transition from trans-granular-dominated cracking at high stress levels to mixed inter- and trans-granular cracking at intermediate stresses and inter-granular-dominated cracking at lower stresses, accompanied by distinct damage localization modes and the evolution of crack paths from grain boundary to grain-interior propagation. The results further quantify the linkage between microscopic fracture mechanisms and macroscopic creep rupture behaviour, including changes in rupture ductility and creep life. Under high-stress conditions, deformation-driven trans-granular damage localization promotes ductile rupture through extensive strain accumulation, whereas under lower-stress conditions, time-dependent grain-boundary damage accumulation leads to quasi-brittle rupture through localized inter-granular fracture.

AI.tldr: 该文通过统一的晶体塑性断裂框架，揭示了高温蠕变中晶界空洞化与滑移诱导穿晶开裂之间的应力依赖竞争关系，及其对宏观韧脆转变的调控机制。
AI.motivation: 高温蠕变涉及多尺度变形与失效机制的复杂耦合，晶间与穿晶开裂之间的权衡决定了蠕变断裂行为的转变，但其微观力学基础及与宏观韧脆转变的联系尚未明确。
AI.method: 构建统一的晶体塑性断裂框架，在显式多晶微结构中耦合晶体塑性、晶界空洞化与晶体学裂纹扩展，模拟应力依赖的竞争开裂行为。
AI.result: 微观计算显示：高应力下以穿晶开裂为主，中应力下为混合晶间/穿晶开裂，低应力下以晶间开裂为主，并伴随不同损伤局域化模式与裂纹路径从晶界向晶内演化；量化了微观断裂机制与宏观蠕变断裂行为（延性、寿命）的联系。
AI.conclusion: 高应力下变形驱动的穿晶损伤局域化通过大量应变累积促进韧性断裂；低应力下时间相关的晶界损伤累积导致局域晶间断裂，引发准脆性断裂。

title: Ultra-small-angle graphene twistronics with monolayer spacers: From interlayer hybridisation and moiré effects to high-temperature magnetotransport oscillations
summary: Based on the analysis of moiré superlattice characteristics and interlayer hybridisation in small-angle twisted graphene multilayers with a monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) spacer, we predict spectral features and quantum transport effects in these systems. Here, we consider both a twisted bilayer and double bilayers with a spacer, discuss double bilayers in two stacking orders - with and without inversion symmetry - and also compare the results obtained with self-consistent Hartree calculations with and without in-plane periodic charge distribution, offering computationally efficient models for these graphene/hBN/graphene moiré systems. We note parametric intervals where the appearance of minibands can be enhanced by tuning with an out-of-plane displacement field, and identify the miniband edges and van Hove singularities across a broad range of densities and displacement fields. These system host Lifshitz transitions at which the Fermi lines form a network across moiré Brillouin zones, and to which Brown-Zak oscillations converge at low magnetic field and elevated temperatures. We analyse interlayer hybridisation across the same parameter space, discuss how hybridisation affects in-plane magneto-transport in ultra-high-mobility structures, and predict that semiclassical magneto-oscillations of interlayer hybridisation can lead to 1/B-periodic quantum oscillations of resistivity persistent to high temperature.

AI.tldr: 研究了含单层hBN间隔层的小角度扭转石墨烯多层体系的莫尔超晶格与层间杂化，预测其光谱特征、量子输运效应及磁输运行为。
AI.motivation: 基于对含单层hBN间隔层的小角度扭转石墨烯多层体系中莫尔超晶格特征和层间杂化的分析，预测这些体系的谱学特征与量子输运效应。
AI.method: 考虑带间隔层的扭转双层和双双层结构，分析具有/不具有反演对称性的两种堆叠顺序；对比有无面内周期电荷分布的自洽Hartree计算，提供计算高效的模型。
AI.result: 给出可通过面外位移场调控增强微带的参数区间，识别微带边缘与van Hove奇点；发现Lifshitz转变及低温高场下Brown-Zak振荡收敛；层间杂化可导致1/B周期的量子振荡在高温下持续。
AI.conclusion: 层间杂化影响超高迁移率结构的面内磁输运，其半经典磁振荡可产生对高温持久的电阻率量子振荡。

title: Chiral Central Charge from Real-Space Twist Operator Correlator
summary: Recent years have witnessed substantial progress in the entanglement-based characterization of quantum phases of matter, with growing interest in real-space formulas due to their theoretical and experimental relevance. For two-dimensional gapped quantum systems, we propose a universal real-space formula for the chiral central charge based on the twist-operator correlator $Z_{g,h}=\langleψ^{(N)}\rvert\mathcal{T}_A(g)\mathcal{T}_B(h)\mathcal{T}_C(g)\mathcal{T}_C(h)\lvertψ^{(N)}\rangle$, where $\lvertψ^{(N)}\rangle=\lvertψ\rangle^{\otimes N}$ is the $N$-copy state and $g,h\in S_N$ are permutations. The twist operator $\mathcal{T}_R(g)$ permutes the $N$ replicas within region $R$ according to $g$. For pairs $(g,h)$ satisfying the spherical condition, we show that the phase of the correlator is determined by the chiral central charge $\mathfrak{c}_{-}$ through $Z_{g,h}/\left\lvert Z_{g,h}\right\rvert=(θ_gθ_h/θ_{gh})^{\mathfrak{c}_{-}}$, where $θ_g^{\mathfrak{c}_{-}}$ is the topological spin of the twist defect labeled by $g\in S_N$. The construction applies to both bosonic and fermionic systems. We derive the formula within a field-theoretic framework under suitable assumptions and further test it numerically in microscopic lattice models. Our results establish a universal connection between real-space entanglement structures and the chiral central charge, providing a systematic framework for characterizing chiral topological phases directly on the lattice.

AI.tldr: 提出基于twist算符关联函数的实空间公式，用N副本置换算符关联函数的相位普适地刻画二维有能隙量子系统的手性中心荷。
AI.motivation: 现有量子相纠缠刻画多依赖抽象拓扑数据，缺乏实空间公式；实空间刻画在理论与实验上更具相关性，尤其需要直接刻画二维手性拓扑相的手性中心荷。
AI.method: 构造twist算符关联函数Z_{g,h}=⟨ψ^{(N)}|T_A(g)T_B(h)T_C(g)T_C(h)|ψ^{(N)}⟩，对满足spherical条件的置换对(g,h)，在场论框架下推导其相位与手性中心荷关系，Z/|Z|=(θ_gθ_h/θ_{gh})^{c_-}；适用于玻色与费米系统。
AI.result: 证明关联函数相位由手性中心荷c_-决定，θ_g为twist缺陷拓扑自旋；并在微观晶格模型中进行数值验证。
AI.conclusion: 建立了实空间纠缠结构与手性中心荷的普适联系，为在晶格上直接刻画手性拓扑相提供系统框架。

title: Defect-limited thermal transport in AlN using pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: Aluminum nitride (AlN) is an important thermal management material whose high lattice thermal conductivity is strongly suppressed by oxygen impurities. We investigate phonon scattering by oxygen-related defects using pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), molecular dynamics (MD), and phonon Boltzmann transport calculations. Several pretrained MLIPs are benchmarked against density functional theory for phonon dispersions and pristine thermal conductivity. To balance accuracy and computational speed, we use a fine-tuned version of the compact SevenNet-Nano model for MD simulations. Monte Carlo annealing supports the formation of bound $V_{\mathrm{Al}}(\mathrm{O_N})_3$ complexes, whose scattering differs from that of their isolated constituents. Defect scattering rates extracted from excess spectral energy density (SED) linewidths agree reasonably with harmonic $T$-matrix predictions at low oxygen contents, supporting the independent-scatterer approximation. Incorporating these rates into an iterative Boltzmann transport equation with Bose--Einstein statistics yields thermal conductivities comparable to experimental values and captures their observed decrease with oxygen content. At high concentrations, however, the scattering rate deviates from linear scaling with oxygen content, suggesting limitations of independent-defect and pristine-phonon descriptions. These results demonstrate an efficient approach using pretrained MLIPs to quantify defect-limited thermal transport and provide insights into impurity effects beyond the dilute-defect approximation.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用预训练通用机器学习原子间势(MLIPs)结合分子动力学和声子玻尔兹曼输运计算,定量研究了氧杂质缺陷对AlN晶格热导率的散射作用,揭示了缺陷复合体形成及高浓度下的非稀释效应。
AI.motivation: AlN是重要热管理材料,其高晶格热导率受氧杂质强烈抑制,但氧相关缺陷的声子散射机制尚不清晰,需要高效准确的方法来量化缺陷限制的热输运。
AI.method: 对多种预训练MLIPs进行基准测试(对比DFT声子色散与纯净热导率),采用微调后的紧凑SevenNet-Nano模型进行MD模拟;用蒙特卡洛退火研究缺陷复合体形成,从过剩谱能量密度(SED)线宽提取缺陷散射率,并纳入迭代玻尔兹曼输运方程(含Bose-Einstein统计)。
